items.title: DevOps Team Leader
items.location_text: Tel Aviv-Yafo, Tel Aviv District, Israel
items.description: Fireblocks is the company bringing global finance onchain. Backed by over $1 billion in capital, we are the premier digital asset infrastructure provider trusted by thousands of industry-defining financial institutions, including banks, payment providers, fintechs, and global corporates such as BNY Mellon, BNP Paribas, ANZ Bank, Western Union, Stripe, and Revolut. Built for institutional scale and security, our enterprise-grade platform and network have powered over $14 trillion in digital asset transfers worldwide. About The Team At Fireblocks, the DevOps group is responsible for the core infrastructure and enablement for developers. The group consists of 15 engineers, working together to provide standards, abilities and support to RND. The group manages the various Kubernetes clusters, Helm charts and deployment pipelines to name a few. We’re looking for a DevOps Team Leader to join the group, lead the team’s projects and manage several engineers (technically and professionally) to bring upon new capabilities, improvements and to ensure we’re on the frontline of the industry's standards. In this role, you will Manage a team of DevOps engineers. Manage the team’s projects and tasks. Take a major role in the design, building, and operational management of a highly secure and scalable platform. Promote, document, and implement systems infrastructure best practices. Play a mentorship role to team members, constantly promoting improvement in their professional skills. Provide self-service capabilities in order to empower the business’s software engineering teams. Define tasks aimed at reducing/eliminating any repetitive or manual tasks and assist with prioritization. Work with other infra teams on improving health and performance issues of the system. Play a strategic role in designing and building infrastructure for ensuring the highest levels of security and responding swiftly to any new and emerging vulnerabilities and security threats. Actively hands-on on projects and tasks. What will you bring to the role? At least 4 years experience leading a DevOps team. At least 5 years of working experience in a DevOps capacity, working within a fast-paced and fast-evolving SaaS environment. At least 5 years of experience with cloud providers - AWS/Azure. At least 10 years of experience in high-tech companies in DevOps roles or similar positions (such as software engineer, system administrator, automation engineer etc) Proficiency in Linux, Command Line, Git, and CI. Experience in the automation, configuration, and application performance management tools such as Ansible/Chef/Puppet, and Datadog/Prometheus/Grafana. Experience with GitOps methodology and supporting tools. Experience with GitLab Pipelines. AI based mindset - creation of agents and skills to reduce constant workload. Strong system-level troubleshooting skills and ability to identify and resolve high-level scalability, performance issues and complex problems. Strong communication skills in a highly collaborative environment. Advantages: BSC in Computer Science or related technical certificate. Background in software development. FinOps experience. Fireblocks' mission is to enable every business to easily and securely access digital assets and cryptocurrencies. In order to do that, we strongly believe our workforce should be as diverse as our clients, and this is why we embrace diversity and inclusion in all its forms. Please see our candidate privacy policy here .

items.title: Systems Engineering Manager
items.description: Are you ready to get the Easygo Edge? We’re looking for a Systems Engineering Manager to lead our systems engineering function for IT at Easygo - a crew surpassing 1,500 globally, powering Stake and KICK, two of the world’s largest online entertainment and livestreaming platforms. You’ll own the platforms your team runs and the engineering roadmap that moves them forward, with real exposure to AI, cloud and automation at global scale. What you’ll build with us: This is a hands-on leadership role. You’ll lead a team of systems engineers and systems administrators from day one, while still writing code, building integrations and shipping the internal platforms and AI-powered tools Easygo teams rely on. You’ll set the engineering standards, keep BAU and project work properly separated, and make sure everything your team builds is documented, operationalised and handed over cleanly. You’ll get real ownership, a modern stack and the chance to shape how a global business builds with AI safely. We know that innovation ignites when we build and create together, in person. This is a full-time opportunity at our Melbourne office. You’ll work right where it all happens, surrounded by our fearless crew shipping high-impact work. Who is Easygo? We’re a high-growth, high-velocity tech company with millions of eyeballs on us every day. We’re building the future of fearless tech. We’re the creators behind some of the most popular brands including Stake, KICK and Easygo Games. While they command a fierce global following, our crew is employed directly by Easygo and that’s where the real fun happens. We’re always looking for people who are hungry, humble and move fast. People who are ready to Unify , Disrupt and Evolve with us. With us you’ll grow faster and go further. Your work has impact. And that gives you an edge you can’t get anywhere else. The impact you’ll make: Lead and develop a team of systems engineers and administrators, from hiring and 1:1s to goals and career growth Own the engineering roadmap, balancing BAU and project work so platforms stay healthy while delivery keeps moving Design and build internal platforms, tools and mini products, taking them from idea to supported service Lead AI initiatives from prototype to production using LLM APIs, MCP connectors and agent patterns, with logging, access control and human review built in Set the patterns for building with AI safely and give business teams practical guidance and starter templates Build production-grade automation on n8n and integrate SaaS and internal systems through APIs and webhooks Deliver Jira, Atlassian, Google Workspace and Slack automation projects that remove manual work Run engineering the right way: Git, pull request review, CI/CD, infrastructure as code and containers Build on AWS and Google Cloud, handle cloud networking, DNS and Cloudflare, and manage End User Compute and FleetDM Make sure everything you ship is monitored, documented and handed over cleanly, and step in as the escalation point for major incidents Your track record: 8+ years in systems, infrastructure or platform engineering, designing and delivering platforms, not only administering them 3 to 5 years directly managing technical staff, including hiring, performance management and code or design reviews, with a coaching mindset Uses AI tools in your engineering every day, and can walk us through something you’ve built with AI, how you secured it and what you’d change Experience with MCP, LLM APIs or agent frameworks in an internal tooling context, and a practical approach that helps people build safely rather than defaulting to no Strong Python, Bash or similar scripting to a standard others can maintain, plus APIs, webhooks and n8n or a similar workflow tool Strong Git workflows, CI/CD (GitHub Actions or similar), Terraform or equivalent, Docker, and working knowledge of DNS and Cloudflare Hands-on AWS and/or Google Cloud, and SaaS platform engineering across Google Workspace, Slack and Atlassian Cloud, including Jira automation Clear communication with technical and non-technical audiences, strong runbook and handover skills, and the autonomy to own outcomes end to end Bonus points if you also have: Familiarity with MDM and End User Compute tooling such as FleetDM, Intune or Jamf Working knowledge of network engineering concepts, with a focus on cloud networking Experience supporting a distributed, multi-entity or global IT environment Benefits that give you the Easygo Edge, so you can build the future of fearless tech with us: Disrupt: we push boundaries and play to win Ballots for major sporting and music events Time with our partners and ambassadors, and exclusive office sessions with leading streamers, creators and industry guests Spin the Wheel Fridays on your birthday and work anniversary, with prizes up to $1,000 or a car EV subscriptions, novated leasing, energy savings through Origin, and everyday discounts and cash back through Paylab Rewards Evolve: we’re in constant motion, personally and professionally The ultimate sandbox: 1 in 3 of our people level up their role every year. If you deliver, you move. Market-synced pay, a performance-based bonus and a high-value referral bonus 30 days combined annual and personal leave for full-time employees 18 weeks paid parental leave for primary carers and 2 weeks for secondary carers, plus a 12-week return to work with fully paid Fridays off Employee Assistance Program for you and your family, and 7% off Bupa health cover with extras waiting periods waived Wednesday massages, a meditation space, parenting facilities, and bike storage, lockers and showers for active commuters Unify: we move as one and win together Daily catered breakfast, free barista coffee, juices and smoothies, and snack walls and drink fridges on every floor Pool tables, table tennis, gaming consoles, an F1 simulator, social sports teams and the Corporate Games Mid-year and end-of-year celebrations, team budgets for wins and milestones, and a paid volunteer day each year Benefits apply to Australian-based employees, are subject to eligibility and program terms, and may change. We play fair. We hire fair. True to our value of ‘Play fair’ we always hire fair. Our work and our brands are fuelled by our diverse culture. We hire for talent and grit. But we never discriminate. Your race, religion, nationality, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital, veteran, or disability status won’t affect our hiring decision, or your trajectory here. Come as you are and get the Easygo edge.

items.title: Dedicated Support Engineering Lead
items.description: About the Team OpenAI’s User Operations team shepherds our customers’ adoption of AI and ensures that our customers' product experience is nothing short of exceptional. We are building the very first post-AGI support team. We resolve complex issues, provide technical guidance, and support customers in maximizing value and adoption from deploying our products. We work closely with Sales, Technical Success, Product, Engineering and others, to deliver the best possible experience to our customers at scale. OpenAI's customers represent a range of diverse backgrounds and maturity, from early-stage startups to established global enterprises. Within Premium Support, Dedicated Support Engineers combine deep technical troubleshooting with an enduring understanding of our most strategic customers’ architectures, critical workloads, and business priorities. Through proactive reliability work, ownership during incidents, and AI-powered support capabilities, we help customers operate successfully as their use of OpenAI grows. About the Role We are looking for a leader to build and develop a team of Dedicated Support Engineers supporting OpenAI’s most strategic enterprise customers. Reporting to the Head of Dedicated Support Engineering, you will lead a team expected to include approximately 10–15 engineers. Your team will work directly with customers and partner with Product, Engineering, and field teams to resolve complex technical problems and help customers run critical artificial intelligence workloads reliably. You will combine people leadership with strong technical judgment, guiding challenging investigations and customer escalations while coaching engineers to make sound decisions independently. Beyond resolving incidents, you will help the team develop a deep understanding of customers’ architectures and business priorities, identify recurring risks, and turn those insights into proactive reliability work and product improvements. You will shape how the team operates as it grows: establishing account ownership, planning capacity and coverage, building shared knowledge, and improving playbooks and handoffs. Working with the function head, you will contribute to reliable, round-the-clock support coverage and broader service improvements, including carefully tested artificial intelligence and automation that increase quality and capacity. The ideal candidate brings technical depth, a record of developing experienced engineers, and the ability to build effective teams and operating practices in a rapidly changing environment. This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. In this role you will: - Hire, coach, and develop experienced engineers, with clear expectations for performance, customer ownership, and independent decision-making. - Plan account coverage and team capacity, balancing customer support with proactive reliability work and preparation for critical events. - Guide technical investigations and customer escalations, coordinate with Engineering, and verify that the customer’s problem is resolved. - Use customer issues and service data to improve playbooks, reduce recurring problems, and inform Product and Engineering priorities. - Build and test artificial intelligence and automation improvements, with quality checks, human oversight, and measurable results. You might thrive in this role if you: - Have 10+ years of relevant technical customer experience, including 5+ years of people leadership in Support Engineering, Technical Account Management, or a comparable team. - Have directly managed experienced engineers supporting strategic enterprise customers, with evidence of effective coaching, delegation, and performance management. - Bring technical depth in application programming interfaces, distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, and enterprise integrations, with sound judgment during complex investigations. - Build trusted customer relationships and work across teams to resolve competing priorities, clarify ownership, and follow through on commitments. - Have delivered measurable improvements through artificial intelligence, automation, or support processes, balancing efficiency with customer experience and reliability. Our team covers a diverse range of functions, including leasing, global operations, analytics, construction, workplace experience, and employee services. We strive to support OpenAI’s mission of researching and deploying safe artificial general intelligence that benefits all of humanity by optimizing the employee experience and maintaining operational excellence and financial discipline through rigorous focus on flexibility, cost effectiveness, intentional design, and scalable, people-centric solutions. About the Role We are seeking an experienced workplace leader to own the workplace experience for our New York City office. The core of this role is business partnership, employee experience, and workplace programs: understanding the needs of NYC-based teams and turning them into practical services that align with OpenAI’s broader workplace standards. Alongside your own workplace responsibilities, you will manage a team member focused on hard-services facilities, setting priorities, coaching their development, and overseeing delivery. This role is part of Americas Workplace Operations and works closely with Workplace Experience, Global Food Programs, People, Executive Business Partners, Corporate Security, IT, and Facilities specialists. This position is based in New York, NY, with the requirement of being in the office 5 days per week. In this role, you will: - Own the day-to-day workplace experience in New York City, ensuring the office is welcoming, well run, and responsive to local employee and business needs. - Build relationships with NYC leaders and the teams you support; anticipate growth, seating, onboarding, and visitor needs, and turn feedback into practical service improvements. - Manage and develop a facilities-focused team member, setting clear expectations, reviewing priorities and delivery, and maintaining accountability for service quality and follow-through. - Own local workplace programs and partner with Workplace Experience, Food Programs, and Events to deliver services and initiatives that strengthen culture and connection in NYC. - Oversee hard-services facilities work through your direct report, reviewing maintenance priorities, vendor performance, and open issues; support escalations and involve Facilities specialists or building engineering as needed. - Partner with your direct report, NYC building management, and service providers to resolve facilities needs and communicate business impacts, with your direct report leading day-to-day coordination and follow-through. - Partner with IT, Corporate Security, People, Executive Business Partners, and other REW teams on office readiness, moves, employee needs, and responses to workplace disruptions. - Monitor local service quality, spending, and recurring issues; use employee feedback and operational data to prioritize improvements and escalate risks. - Communicate workplace updates clearly and proactively, and maintain accurate NYC-specific guidance on office services, workplace programs, and policies. items.title: Software Engineer, Datacenter Server Lifecycle
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Anthropic is investing $50 billion in American computing infrastructure, including datacenters custom-built for our workloads, and this role sits at the heart of that effort. As a Staff Engineer on the Datacenter Server Lifecycle team, you will own the end-to-end operational journey of every machine in our datacenters – from initial provisioning and deployment, steady-state operation, maintenance, and repair. This is greenfield work: you will help define the services, tooling, standards and processes that govern how we operate critical hardware at scale, powering frontier model development and serving. You will have the opportunity to define AI-native workflows for datacenter operations and to help drive innovations on efficiency, performance, and reliability. A distinguishing aspect of this role is its deep intersection with security. The machines in our datacenter handle some of the most sensitive workloads in AI – training frontier models and serving millions of users interacting with Claude. Ensuring that every machine in the fleet is trusted, attested, and operating with a verified chain of integrity from the hardware up is a core part of the job, not an afterthought. You will partner closely with our Infrastructure Security team to define and enforce trusted compute standards across the lifecycle, from secure provisioning through end-of-life handling. Key responsibilities Build automation to support datacenter fleets at scale. Define and own the end-to-end system lifecycle strategy – from provisioning and deployment through operation, maintenance, refresh, and decommissioning – and maintain automation and operational procedures for common lifecycle events (e.g., hardware failures, firmware upgrades, fleet rotations). Partner closely with Infrastructure Security to design and enforce trusted compute standards across the server lifecycle. Work closely with our Networking team to ensure end-to-end connectivity across all sites. Build and maintain tooling to track machine health, configuration, and operational status across the full datacenter fleet. Minimum qualifications Hands-on experience with server hardware, including rack deployment, cabling, troubleshooting, and understanding failure modes at scale. End-to-end understanding of hardware lifecycle management: asset tracking, provisioning workflows, maintenance scheduling, and decommissioning practices. Proficiency in at least one programming language (e.g., Python, Rust, Go, or Java). Working knowledge of modern cloud infrastructure, including Kubernetes and large scale cloud providers (e.g. AWS, Azure, GCP). Ability to communicate clearly and build consensus with a wide range of stakeholders. Comfort navigating ambiguity and making progress on complex, cross-functional problems. Willingness to travel occasionally to datacenter sites across North America. Preferred qualifications 8+ years of experience in datacenter infrastructure management, or a closely related discipline. Hands-on experience with GPU or AI accelerator hardware (e.g., NVIDIA A100/H100, Google TPUs, or AWS Trainium) and an understanding of their operational demands. Familiarity with modern provisioning and OS tooling such as LinuxBoot and NixOS Experience building or contributing to datacenter automation or fleet management platforms. Experience building and deploying server operating system distributions across large server fleets. Background in large-scale capacity planning and hardware refresh strategy, ideally at a hyperscaler or large cloud provider. Experience with trusted compute and hardware security concepts such as secure boot, TPM, hardware attestation, and firmware verification — or a strong desire to develop deep expertise in this area. The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $405,000 — $485,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

items.title: Applied AI Engineer, CyberSecurity, Defense
items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. ROLE SUMMARY We are seeking an Applied AI, Forward Deployed Engineer to build customer use cases on top of the Mistral stack for our defense, government and critical-infrastructure customers. You will turn "we have agents" into "we shipped something a client uses." This role is about composing cybersecurity-related agentic workflows focused on cyberdefense, configuring harnesses for real-world scenarios, and delivering value directly to clients — often in sovereign, on-premises or classified environments. You will work with some of the most security-sensitive organizations in the world: government agencies, sovereign institutions and operators of critical infrastructure. They need AI that is powerful, controllable and deployable on their terms. Why this role: you will build some of the first AI-for-cyberdefense systems deployed in real government and defense environments, on frontier models you can influence. You will work in a tight-knit team alongside elite experts in DFIR and cyberdefense — people who are passionate about their craft — and the patterns you implement at customer sites feed directly back into Mistral's internal use cases and products. Few roles put this much frontier technology this close to missions that matter. WHAT YOU WILL DO Client-Facing Agentic Solutions - You'll individually help deploy into production use cases with considerable business impact, with defense and government cybersecurity assignments as a priority - You'll work on state-of-the-art GenAI applications, driving a crucial technological transformation together with our customers - Tackle iconic customer use cases that no existing solution on the market can address — from custom configuration of cybersecurity harnesses for cloud defense, to agentic alert triage and investigation, incident response automation, detection engineering, threat intelligence analysis, and security log analysis at scale - You'll be involved in pre-sales calls to understand potential customers' needs, challenges, and aspirations, providing technical guidance on our products and explaining Mistral technologies to various stakeholders - You'll collaborate with our product and science teams to continuously improve our product and model capabilities based on customer feedback - Ship secure by design. Apply least-privilege access, secrets management, authN/authZ best practices, audit logging, human-in-the-loop approval for high-impact actions, and defenses against prompt injection and data exfiltration in agentic systems - Design and run evaluations that measure technical correctness, operational value and safety, so customers can trust what is being deployed - Own deployment end to end — observability, reliability, cost and latency tuning — including on-premises and air-gapped setups where customers require them OUR PRINCIPLES - We care about people and outputs - What matters is what you ship, not the time you spend on it - Bureaucracy is where urgency goes to vanish. You talk to whoever you need to talk to. The best idea wins, whether it comes from a principal engineer or someone in their first week - We say what we mean. Feedback is direct, timely, and given because we care - Always ask why. The best solutions come from deep understanding, not from copying what worked before - No politics. Low ego, high standards - We embrace an unstructured environment and find joy in it SECURITY & COMPLIANCE CRITERIA - Eligibility: must hold citizenship in the target territory (France for now). - Clearable: must meet all local requirements for high-level security clearance ABOUT YOU - You are fluent in French, with strong English — this customer set works in French - You have 5+ years building systems in a cybersecurity context — SOC automation, DFIR automation, detection engineering, security tooling, or similar — with a record of operating what you ship in production - On top of that, you have 1+ year of hands-on experience building agentic or LLM-based systems, ideally in production — with a deep understanding of the concepts: prompting and context engineering, RAG, tool use, agentic orchestration, evaluations, guardrails, and knowing when to use each. If you don't have the production year yet, deep familiarity and the drive to learn fast in real, constrained environments is what we're looking for - You have strong technical coding skills in Python, plus full-stack experience: APIs, back-end services and front-end interfaces (e.g. TypeScript/React) - You have strong communication skills, with an ability to explain complex technical concepts in simple terms to both technical and non-technical audiences Ideally, you have: - Experience with security tooling or workflows (SIEM, SOAR, EDR/XDR, threat intel) - Experience as a Security Operations Engineer, Detection & Response Engineer, or Incident Response Engineer - Experience as a Forward Deployed Engineer, Solutions Architect, Solutions Engineer - Prior work with government, defense, or national-security customers - A bias toward action and delivery — you ship fast, operate independently with a customer-led mindset, and reuse internal building blocks effectively - Strong problem-solving abilities, attention to detail, and a collaborative attitude WHAT WE OFFER We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks. For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link. PRIVACY POLICY Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/applicant-privacy-policy.

items.title: Head of PMO, Workplace
items.location_text: New York City, NY; San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY; Seattle, WA
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role We are seeking a Head of PMO to build the system that lets Anthropic's Real Estate & Workplace organization operate at a much larger scale. As a member of the organization's leadership team, you will build and manage the team that runs the program management office across all four of our functions: Food & Beverage, Facilities, Portfolio Strategy & Transactions, and Construction Delivery. You have three mandates: make our processes work as one system, find and control cost across the real estate lifecycle, and give leadership the data to make large financial decisions with confidence. You will build dashboards that show how the business is operating. Function leaders own their decisions and results. You own the system that makes those results visible, comparable, and repeatable across offices and specialized facilities in North America, Europe, and APAC. This is a senior role with year-long, organization-wide scope: you will define the problem, set the plan, and be in the room when our biggest operating decisions are made. Key responsibilities Process & Operating Model Set the annual vision and roadmap for the PMO, and bring it in house from our external project management partner without disrupting active work Take over the implementation of our new project management platform from our external partner, and drive it to full rollout and adoption Own the stage gates and handoffs that carry work from initial request through opening day, across Portfolio Strategy & Transactions, Construction Delivery, Facilities, and F&B, with standard templates, clear owners, and deadlines Standardize vendor agreements and benchmarks across regions, with Construction Delivery, Legal, and function leaders owning contract positions Cost & Capital Discipline Build capex variance controls with Construction Delivery, tracking budget burn, contingency, and change orders so overruns are caught early Benchmark facilities and food service spend across regions and flag outliers to function leaders, who own any renegotiation Partner with Finance, along with function leaders, on capital plans and operating budgets, tracking commitments, forecasts, and variances across the organization Quantify the savings and avoided costs the PMO delivers, and report them to leadership Business Intelligence & Planning Build the leadership dashboards, tracking data such as desks against headcount, leasing deals against plan, time from need to space, on-time delivery, and cost per square foot against budget Turn that data into insights and recommendations that inform future real estate roadmaps, then lead operating improvements across functions and measure whether they worked Run the organization's operating rhythm and executive reporting to Finance, Chief People Officer, and other senior leaders, including the recurring Real Estate Forum Find where Claude and automation can replace manual tracking, reporting, and document work, and put those changes into daily use Team & Cross-Functional Leadership Determine what team the PMO needs at our scale, then hire, manage, and develop it Hold external partners to the roles, standards, and decision authority Anthropic has defined Adjust the PMO's approach quickly as company priorities shift, and bring the organization along Minimum qualifications Have built a PMO or business operations function from the ground up and scaled it across multiple teams and regions Have built metrics and dashboards that senior leaders used to make decisions, and can define the data model behind them Have led software rollouts through to real adoption, not only go-live Bring strong financial acumen across capital plans, operating budgets, forecasting, and variance analysis Understand construction delivery, real estate transactions, and facilities operations well enough to earn credibility with experts and spot when the data is wrong Have managed teams, including defining roles and hiring for a function that did not yet exist Have led through influence with senior peers who do not report to you, and have changed how an organization operates as a result Write clearly and concisely, producing decision-ready material for executives with minimal revision Stay steady through ambiguity and rapid change, and help others do the same Care about Anthropic's mission of developing AI safely Hold a Bachelor's degree, or equivalent professional experience Preferred qualifications Have 10+ years of experience, or equivalent, in PMO, business operations, or program leadership, with significant time in corporate real estate and/or workplace Have supported a hypergrowth technology company scaling its global footprint Bring experience across North America, EMEA, and APAC Have hands-on experience with construction project management, lease administration, occupancy, or facilities platforms (Procore, Visual Lease, OfficeSpace, Corrigo) and BI tools (Looker, Tableau, Power BI) Have worked in management consulting, corporate strategy, or business operations, in addition to your real estate experience Have used AI tools to automate meaningful parts of an operations function Have moved a program from an outsourced project management partner to an in-house team Hold a PMP, PgMP, CoreNet MCR, or MBA The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $315,000 — $465,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

items.title: Product Security Engineer, Offensive Security
items.description: Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” Learn more about working at Coinbase . As an Offensive Security Engineer on the Application Security team within Security, you'll pioneer how Coinbase uses frontier AI models to scale vulnerability discovery, red team AI systems, and automate security workflows. This role bridges traditional penetration testing with next-generation AI-augmented offensive security, directly accelerating our ability to protect products and customers. You'll own the development of AI-driven security tooling and collaborate across Vulnerability Management, Offensive Security, and Incident Response to fundamentally shift how we operate. What you'll do: Build, deploy, and maintain custom security scanners that leverage frontier models to detect vulnerabilities at scale across Coinbase's product surface. Lead red teaming efforts against internal AI systems, including jailbreak testing, prompt injection analysis, and tool abuse simulation. Develop AI-driven automation for vulnerability triage, validation, and remediation workflows to accelerate the bug bounty and vulnerability response pipelines. Partner with engineering teams to prioritize, remediate, and verify fixes for critical vulnerabilities discovered through AI-augmented and manual testing. Mentor junior security engineers on integrating AI into offensive security workflows to scale team capabilities. Required Skills and Experience: 3+ years of experience in application security, penetration testing, or offensive security with demonstrated ability to build custom security tooling. Hands-on experience using LLMs or frontier models to automate security tasks, scale vulnerability research, or build security scanners. Demonstrated experience red teaming AI-based systems (prompt injection, jailbreak testing, tool abuse). Deep understanding of common vulnerability classes (OWASP Top 10, SANS Top 25) and proven track record identifying and exploiting them in production environments. Proficiency in at least one programming language (Python, Go, or similar) with experience writing production-grade security tooling. Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality. Pay Transparency Notice: Base salary varies by location (see range below). Total compensation may also include equity and bonus eligibility, and benefits (medical, dental, vision, 401(k)). Applicants with criminal histories will be considered consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws. US Applicants: View Employee Rights , Know Your Rights , and E-Verify Notice of Participation. Accommodations: If you are an individual with a disability who needs a reasonable accommodation, email us your request and contact info at accommodations[at]coinbase.com. Need screen reading technology? Click here to download a free compatible screen reader and view the tutorial . Data Privacy & Arbitration: By submitting your application, you agree to our Candidate Privacy Notice . US applicants: By submitting your application, you agree to Arbitration of Disputes .

items.title: Builder Education
items.description: About the team Customer Education helps enterprises develop the capabilities their workforce needs to use AI effectively, build and deploy AI solutions, and get more value from OpenAI’s products. About the role We’re looking for a hands-on technical educator who enjoys building with AI and helping others learn to do the same. You’ll create practical education for enterprise developers building with OpenAI’s APIs and working with Codex. You’ll turn real customer use cases into clear lessons, working examples and hands-on labs, building on our established portfolio of bootcamps, webinars and technical content. The goal is to help builders develop skills they can apply to their own applications and development workflows. This role combines technical development, learning design and live teaching. You’ll build and test what you teach, work directly with learners and create resources that can be reused across in-person, live virtual and self-paced learning. Working closely with the Builder Education team, you’ll independently own defined content, lab and delivery workstreams. You’ll partner with technical experts and customer-facing teams to keep learning accurate, useful and current as products evolve. In this role, you will: - Build practical technical education. Turn customer needs into clear learning objectives, lessons, demonstrations and exercises. Sequence concepts, practice, feedback and assessments so learners can build and apply new skills. - Create hands-on labs and learning environments. Build working examples and reliable, secure lab infrastructure. Use automation and platform integrations to make setup, access and delivery repeatable as programs grow. - Teach directly and improve through practice. Deliver in-person bootcamps and live virtual sessions, explain technical concepts clearly and help learners troubleshoot. Use their questions and feedback to improve the experience. - Own content from concept through launch. Work with technical experts to develop, test and publish content, code examples and labs. Maintain technical accuracy and update materials as products and customer needs change. - Make learning reusable. Adapt content across bootcamps, webinars and self-paced courses, and create resources that customers, internal teams and partners can use independently. - Run defined program workstreams. Manage scope, timelines and dependencies, coordinate contributors and support program operations. Build repeatable processes that keep content, environments and delivery ready for learners. - Use evidence to improve learning. Assess whether builders can apply what they learn, and work with program and analytics partners to understand how programs support product adoption and continued use. You might thrive in this role if you: - Have hands-on technical experience in software development, cloud infrastructure or AI workflows, and have built applications, integrated APIs, used Git or other version control and worked with coding agents. You can share examples of applications, API integrations or AI workflows you personally delivered. - Can turn complex technical topics into clear learning experiences, with purposeful practice and ways to assess whether learners can apply new skills. - Have built and maintained hands-on labs or technical learning environments for external customer or developer audiences, with attention to reliability, security and ease of use. - Are an engaging teacher and clear writer who can explain technical decisions, respond to learner questions and troubleshoot live. - Stay curious about AI, explore new capabilities firsthand and test the code and workflows you teach. You use learner feedback to improve your work. - Have independently owned a technical learning program from an ambiguous brief through launch and iteration, making practical scope decisions and contributing across content, teaching and program operations. - Have experience beyond education-only settings, working with product, engineering or customer teams. Experience in a fast-paced tech environment is preferred. Nice to have: - Experience with infrastructure automation tools such as Terraform and integrations that support technical labs. - Experience with learning platforms, LMS/SCORM, certification or assessment design, or learning analytics. - Relevant technical certifications or experience delivering technical training across live and self-paced formats. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement https://cdn.openai.com/policies/eeo-policy-statement.pdf. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations. items.title: Deal Operations Strategist
items.location_text: United States, New York, San Francisco
items.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. ABOUT THE ROLE You'll be the go-to deal desk and pricing expert for ElevenLabs' North American sales team -- the person that the sales team comes to when a deal is complex, competitive, or needs to move fast. You'll own pricing strategy and deal structuring for our most critical customers, partnering with stakeholders to get non-standard terms across the line, and build the processes that make the whole machine run faster. - Own the pricing and deal structure for complex enterprise deals, advising sales on commercials and trade-offs in real time to keep things moving toward close. - Work closely with engineering to maintain and evolve our Configure Price Quote tool. - Translate customer requirements into deal structures that work commercially and operationally, knowing where to flex and where to hold firm. - Own the path through internal complexity, aligning Finance, Legal, Product, and leadership so deals don't stall on process. - Partner with Finance to build deal-level P&L models and communicate pricing trends back to the business, informing strategic pricing decisions at the leadership level - Develop and maintain pricing frameworks, discount guardrails, and approval policies that scale with the business. - Build the analytics and feedback loops that surface where deals are slowing down and why — and fix it. REQUIREMENTS - Hands‑on experience configuring and maintaining CPQ rulesets, price books, and approval workflows. - Experience in finance or deal pricing at a company, or experience within investment banking or management consulting - Excellent financial modeling, verbal, and written communication skills - Proven track record of process optimizations or automation. - Ability to make value judgements that balance business, financial, and legal priorities. Bonus: - Knowledge of AI/ML industry pricing models and competitive landscape - Experience scaling deal desk processes in a high-growth environment LOCATION This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in the United States, however the ability to operate in EST, CST, or PST timezones is required. #LI-Remote We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

items.title: Staff+ Software Engineer, Deployment
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Every change to Anthropic's software has to reach production somehow: new code, runtime configuration, feature flags, infrastructure changes. Our team builds the systems those changes travel through. Our mission is to give every team at Anthropic a fast, safe, and predictable path from change to production. You'll join the team within Anthropic's Infrastructure organization that owns pipelines, staged rollouts, health-gated promotion, and rollback, along with runtime configuration, feature flags, and the systems that deliver code and artifacts to machines across a very large fleet. You'll own a meaningful part of this end to end, from design through operating it in production. If you want your work to shape how fast and how safely Anthropic ships, this could be a great fit. Key responsibilities Set technical direction for major parts of the deployment platform and own them end to end: design, implementation, operations, and on-call Build rollout safety into the platform, including progressive delivery, health-gated promotion, automatic pause and rollback, and deploy controls that teams manage themselves Design APIs and abstractions that work equally well for engineers and for AI agents Extend the platform to new workload types and runtimes, from Kubernetes to serverless and edge platforms Build and operate runtime configuration and feature flag systems with validation, gradual rollout, and fast rollback Build infrastructure-as-code workflows that many teams rely on for safe, routine changes Scale artifact distribution so code and configuration reach machines quickly and efficiently Partner with Security so that the path to production is secure by default, with verifiable builds, least-privilege access, and auditable changes Work directly with teams across Anthropic to understand their deployment needs and bring their workloads onto the platform Take part in on-call and incident response, and turn what you learn into guardrails so the same problem can't recur Minimum qualifications Proficiency in at least one backend or systems programming language, such as Rust, Go, C++, or Java Experience leading the design, building, and operation of distributed systems or infrastructure in production, including technical direction across teams Experience with cloud infrastructure and containerized workloads, such as Kubernetes on AWS or GCP Strong written and verbal communication skills Preferred qualifications Experience building deployment, release, or change management systems at large scale Experience with production on-call and incident response Experience with Rust in production Experience with progressive delivery and GitOps tooling, such as Argo CD or Argo Rollouts Deep knowledge of Kubernetes, including controllers and operators Experience with Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code systems at scale, including state management and locking Experience building feature flag, experimentation, or dynamic configuration systems Experience with artifact or package distribution, such as OCI registries, Nix, or content-addressed storage Experience with software supply chain security, such as signed build provenance Experience building high-throughput workflow engines or control planes backed by relational databases Experience building internal developer platforms and driving adoption across many teams Experience using AI agents in your own engineering work, or building systems that agents operate Representative projects Build operator controls for progressive rollouts, including pause and resume that preserve rollout state Design a deployment engine built on fine-grained targets and their dependencies, so each change rolls out exactly where it needs to Build cluster-health-aware rollouts that steer around unhealthy clusters Add a new workload type to the platform, including its rollout, verification, and rollback behavior Design a deployment control plane that handles sharp bursts of agent-driven traffic Design a distribution system that delivers configuration and artifacts to every machine in the fleet as demand grows The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: £325,000 — £390,000 GBP Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

items.description: WHO ARE WE? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems. We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! About the team The Cohere Total Rewards team is entering an exciting growth phase! Our mission is to deliver a reward strategy that attracts, retains, and rewards world-class AI talent, in support of Cohere’s rapid global growth. To help us achieve that goal, we’re hiring an experienced Technical Compensation Business Partner to own compensation design and execution for our Technical organization, and help build the compensation foundations for the wider business too. About the Role This is a hands-on individual-contributor role for someone who brings deep experience with AI/ML compensation, and who wants to have a foundational impact on a global business. Reporting into the Head of Total Rewards, you will partner closely with Technical leaders, HR Business Partners, Talent, Finance, and other cross-functional teams, leading market benchmarking, offers, and program design for highly sought-after technical talent - as well as contributing to wider compensation projects. You’ll thrive in this role if you’re comfortable operating in ambiguity, have strong judgment and the ability to independently execute, and understand how to balance speed with thoughtfulness. This role also requires significant experience with international compensation. Key responsibilities - Act as the dedicated Compensation Business Partner for the Technical organization - owning compensation benchmarking, competitive intelligence, market analysis, and offer management for Technical roles across all markets; - Act as a trusted compensation advisor to our HRBPS and to leaders in our Technical org, supporting them with complex, high-stakes decisions - Design compensation programs, processes, and ways of working that support Cohere’s fast-growing business; - Support the design and delivery of our cyclical pay reviews, equity incentives, and other major programs, and own your groups’ compensation cycle actions end to end; - Act as a SME for our compensation technology and tooling; - Collaborate with the wider Compensation team and other stakeholders (Legal, Finance, HR Ops, Payroll) on a range of other compensation-related work including policy design, M&A, and pay equity and transparency. Required Experience & Qualifications - 6+ years of compensation experience, including significant experience with compensation for AI/ML talent; - Demonstrated expertise in compensation strategy, benchmarking, and pay range design, preferably in a high-growth environment; - Significant experience with compensation in North America, the UK, and Europe; - Proven ability to bring clarity to ambiguous bodies of work, and own the outcomes; - Strong working knowledge of international compensation practices and the regulatory landscape (e.g. pay transparency); - Strong working knowledge of equity compensation; - Strong analytical skills with the ability to leverage complex data to support rapid decision-making; - Exceptional written and verbal communication skills and the ability to build trust with senior stakeholders; - Adept at educating leaders and managers on compensation fundamentals and driving engagement with compensation programs and initiatives; - Experience deploying and managing Pave or similar compensation platforms. FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS: - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch. - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health. - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme. - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent. - Annual enrichment benefits: Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit. Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching. - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!) - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers https://cohere.com/careers page.

items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About Beneficial Deployments Beneficial Deployments ensures AI reaches and benefits the communities that need it most. We partner with nonprofits, foundations, and mission-driven organizations to deploy Claude in education, global health, economic mobility, and life sciences — focusing on raising the floor for those who need it most. About the Role We're looking for an Applied AI Architect to join Beneficial Deployments, focused on helping nonprofits and foundations get real value from Claude. You'll be the technical lead for a portfolio of partners, working alongside our Account Executives from first conversation through deployment. You'll help partners find where Claude makes a real difference to their mission and their operations, design solutions that fit their budgets, data and teams, and turn early pilots into lasting adoption. What works for one partner becomes something the whole sector can use. Responsibilities Serve as the primary technical advisor to a portfolio of nonprofit partners from discovery through deployment, turning their priorities into scoped use cases with clear measures of success. Partner with Account Executives on account plans, discovery and technical evaluation. Design and demo solutions with Claude, the API and Claude Code across program delivery, fundraising, operations and data analysis. Guide partners through security review, data governance and procurement. Run workshops and trainings that build AI fluency across partner teams. Build reusable assets (reference designs, connectors, prompt and eval templates) so one partner's work helps the next. Spot patterns across partners, bring field insight back to Product and Research, and help partners measure what changed. Travel to partner sites for workshops, technical deep dives and relationship building. You Might Be a Good Fit If You Have 3+ years in customer-facing technical roles such as solutions architecture, sales engineering, forward-deployed engineering or technical consulting. A track record of getting lean, skeptical or slow-moving teams to adopt technology and keep using it, including working through how they buy and govern it. Hands-on experience building with LLM APIs: you have built and evaluated working prototypes or agents, and can guide a partner's own engineers on architecture and evals. You don't need to write production code. Clear written and spoken communication across a broad audience. The ability to explain technical tradeoffs to program leads, operations staff and executives. Patience with long buying cycles, a knack for knowing how to make them go smoothly, and real care for public benefit. A track record of agency and autonomy: you spot what needs doing before anyone asks, agree that it matters, drive it to a finished result and know when to pull others in. Comfort operating in ambiguity: you bring clarity to fuzzy problems, wear multiple hats and do whatever it takes to further the mission. Bonus if you've worked in a sales team, or with or at nonprofits, foundations or other mission-driven organizations. The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. items.title: Motion Design Producer
items.description: About the Team OpenAI didn’t begin as a traditional company. It began as an idea: that artificial intelligence could be developed in a way that benefits everyone. As a creative team, our role is to help make sure the work behind that idea is understood, as it leaves the lab and meets the world. This company works at the frontier of intelligence. Like any frontier, it’s unfinished, constantly shifting, and still being explored. Our job is to stay close to that uncertainty and help shape how this story gets told, in a way that feels grounded and human. We do this through campaigns, launches, films, brand systems, and work that doesn’t fit neatly into any of those categories yet. This team is for people who want to help shape something from the beginning. About the Role OpenAI’s in-house Creative Team is looking for a Motion Design Producer to help shape and scale how our brand comes to life through motion design across every touchpoint — from identity systems and campaigns to product, web, and comms work. You’ll partner closely with our Brand Identity & Brand Design leadership to manage intake, resourcing, timelines, and creative workflows — ensuring design projects move seamlessly from concept to delivery. You’ll serve as the operational backbone of the design practice, building clarity and momentum across a growing cross-functional team. As Motion Design is a shared function in Creative Design, you will also partner closely with other production functional ecosystems to deliver motion design support. This is a highly collaborative role that requires both strategic oversight and hands-on execution. You’ll be a key connector across Marketing, Product, Comms, and Web — driving alignment, enabling great design, and creating the systems that keep our creative work consistent, efficient, and impactful. In this role, you will: - Manage Day-to-day Motion Design Operations: Oversee the end-to-end management of design projects — from scoping and prioritization to delivery — ensuring resources, timelines, and dependencies are well-planned and communicated. - Produce High-Priority Motion Projects: Serve as a hands-on individual contributor (IC) on large, high-priority motion projects, owning production from kickoff through delivery. - Shape Intake & Resourcing: Partner with creative and marketing, creative, production and ops leads to evaluate new requests, define scope, and allocate design capacity across internal and external partners. - Build Cross-Functional Alignment: Act as the connective tissue between design and partner teams (Product, Web, Brand, Comms, and GTM), ensuring design work ladders up to broader strategic goals. - Elevate Systems & Process: Design and implement operational frameworks that enable the design team to scale effectively — from creative reviews and feedback loops to asset tracking and tool optimization. - Manage External Partners: Oversee relationships with design vendors, freelancers, and production partners; ensure output meets OpenAI’s creative and technical standards. - Uphold Craft & Consistency: Partner with the Brand Identity and Brand Design team to ensure design work is cohesive, high-quality, and reflective of OpenAI’s evolving visual identity. You might thrive in this role if you: - Have 8+ years of experience in design production, brand operations, or creative program management within an in-house team or agency environment. - Are fluent in the design process — from concept and iteration through production and delivery — and can anticipate what a creative team needs to succeed. Should be experienced in full identity explorations and production needs. - Are a natural systems-builder who can bring order to complexity without stifling creativity. - Excel at stakeholder management and communication — you’re equally comfortable talking to designers, executives, and engineers. - Are proactive, unflappable, and skilled at driving clarity in fast-moving environments. - Are fluent in tools like Asana, Airtable, Figma, and Google Workspace. - Have experience building or scaling global brand systems. - Have familiarity with motion, 3D, or experiential design production. - Have a strong understanding of creative operations in a technology-driven or design-led organization. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.
