items.title: Chief of Staff, CTO
items.description: Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” Learn more about working at Coinbase . The CTO organization spans 700+ people across Platform, AI, Engineering, Enterprise Engineering and IT. The Chief of Staff to the CTO is a one-person force multiplier. You own the CTO's time, attention, decisions, and follow-through, and increasingly you build the AI agents that run their operating system. What you'll do Own the CTO's operating system: how their week, preparation, and decisions flow, with a running decision and commitment log so decisions get made once, stick, and each follow-up has a named owner. Be where they cannot be: represent them in forums and cross-functional discussions across Platform, AI, Engineering, Core, and the executive team, bring back the signal, and unblock without escalation. Carry their voice: write and edit town halls, AMAs, all-hands remarks, board materials, and Slack posts so their point of view lands crisply and on time. Build and scale AI agents that absorb more of their operating system, freeing your hours for higher-leverage work. Run the few things they own that have no organizational home, from framing to clean handoff, without adding process. Required skills and experience 6+ years in BizOps, strategy, consulting, or technical program leadership, including support of a senior technical executive. Exceptional written and verbal communication: you can write in an executive's voice and turn technical trade-offs into business terms. Technical fluency: you follow architecture, infrastructure, and AI discussions with staff-plus engineers and ask the right questions. You do not need to be a practicing engineer. Judgment and discretion with sensitive org, people, and strategy information, and a clear read on what to escalate, decide, or let go. Influence without authority across senior engineering and cross-functional leaders, earned by being prepared and useful. Personal operating rigor: you track commitments and close loops relentlessly, without building process. Hands-on use of AI tools in your own work; experience in a platform, infrastructure, developer tooling, or AI-focused organization is a plus. Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality. items.title: Research Engineer, AI Monitoring
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Our team builds, tests, deploys, and monitors the classifiers that block internal agents from taking dangerous actions. These classifiers run across RL, evals, and internal deployments, and are designed to catch things like sandbox escape attempts or exfiltration of sensitive data. When a classifier flags an action, it can block the action before the tool call runs, end the task, and alert a human . This is one layer of a defence-in-depth with several layers that reinforce each other: what our classifiers flag feeds into offline monitoring, and the findings from that go back into better classifiers and safer environment design. The work combines research and production engineering: The research problem is building high recall and high precision classifiers to catch rare, novel, and sometimes adversarial behaviour. There are also several narrow research questions to answer - for example, how to deploy safety classifiers inside training environments without incentivising models to evade them. Some research also builds on the multi-stage designs described in our work on Claude Code auto mode and Constitutional Classifiers . The engineering problem is shipping these classifiers into the critical path of research and product work. These classifiers need to cover a huge volume of traffic while operating within cost, latency and availability constraints. Day to day, much of our work is done with Claude: you'll direct agents to run experiments and ship code, and review what they produce. That moves the hard part of the job towards deciding what to do and in what order. Additionally, organisation, communication, and prioritisation skills matter a great deal as our classifiers sit in the path of many other teams' work. Key responsibilities Design, train, and evaluate classifiers that detect unsafe agent actions in real time, owning pieces such as prompted models, trained classifiers, or probes on model internals Deploy, tune and operate these classifiers in the critical path of internal agents, RL training, and evaluations, and own their accuracy, reliability, latency, cost, and failure behaviour Build the datasets, labelling pipelines, and evaluations that allow us to measure and improve our classifiers and harm taxonomies Partner with red teaming colleagues to stress-test our classifiers, and harden them against what they find Work with the teams whose agents, environments, and evaluations we run on, so that false positives get fixed quickly without weakening protection Contribute to the team's direction, including what to build, what to partner on, and where to invest Minimum qualifications Ability to organise and prioritise several parallel streams of work, and to communicate clearly with the teams that work affects Ability to critically review code and experiment results, including work produced by AI agents Sincere interest in developing safe and beneficial AI systems Preferred qualifications Experience leading ambiguous technical projects and setting direction for other engineers or researchers Experience evaluating large language models, developing classifiers, or operating high-scale production systems where requirements change quickly Experience building detection systems where true positives are rare and false positives are costly, such as abuse, fraud, spam, or intrusion detection Experience running low-latency, high-availability services that other systems depend on, including being on call for them Experience fine-tuning language models, or working with probes and other methods that read model internals Experience with LLM inference or serving infrastructure, or with integrating new components into training infrastructure Background in security, such as sandboxing or detection and response Familiarity with research on AI control, scalable oversight, agent safety, or reinforcement learning The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: £375,000 — £640,000 GBP Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. items.title: Researcher, Frontier Robustness
items.description: About the Team The Frontier Robustness team advances the science of securing frontier AI systems. We develop new methods to keep increasingly capable models contained, observable, and under human control, focusing on the sandboxes, shared research infrastructure, and protective systems used during model development and evaluation. We use our most capable models to discover and combine weaknesses across the security stack, studying how they might escape containment, communicate through unauthorized channels, or evade monitoring. We turn these findings into new defenses and test whether protections hold as models, environments, and attack strategies change. About the Role We are looking for a researcher to develop and test new methods for securing frontier AI systems. You will investigate open-ended questions about model behavior, containment, and safeguards—designing experiments, building evaluations, and developing defenses where established approaches may be insufficient. You will work closely with the Security organization to define the problems and translate research findings into practical protections. You will take research from an initial question and threat model through experiment design, reproducible findings, and tested defenses. You will write code, build tools and prototypes, and work closely with researchers and infrastructure owners to turn new ideas into safeguards that work in practice. This requires sound security judgment, comfort with uncertainty, and the ability to devise solutions to problems without established answers. This role is based in San Francisco. In this role, you will: - Design and run experiments using frontier models and hands-on security techniques to discover failure modes in sandboxes, research infrastructure, and the services models can reach. Reproduce vulnerabilities and assess their impact. - Develop threat models and novel adversarial tests for attacks that cross multiple security boundaries, including sandbox escapes, unauthorized communication between agents, and access to sensitive data or systems through shared services. - Invent, prototype, and evaluate defenses that strengthen isolation and limit the impact of a compromised boundary. Study agent permissions and tool configurations to identify excessive access and build layered protections with infrastructure owners. - Develop and red-team model-based safeguards and monitors of model reasoning and actions. Investigate evasion, test new monitoring techniques, and measure when protections detect or prevent unsafe behavior. - Develop automated adversarial tests and repeatable evaluations to measure progress as model capabilities, configurations, and attack strategies change. Assess whether defenses generalize to new attacks, verify fixes, and identify regressions. - Partner across Research, Security, and infrastructure teams, including Agent Security, to prioritize risks and turn findings into deployed improvements while accounting for performance and researcher workflows. You might thrive in this role if you: - Have hands-on experience conducting research with large language models, including designing and running experiments and evaluating model behavior. - Can turn an open-ended question into a clear hypothesis, build reproducible experiments at scale, and use the results to develop or improve a method. - Can design rigorous evaluations, investigate unexpected results, and test whether findings hold across different models, environments, and attack strategies. - Write and debug code independently, build research tools and prototypes, and carry ideas through experimentation. - Bring practical security experience relevant to this work, such as sandboxing, vulnerability research, adversarial testing, or detection and monitoring. - Work effectively with Security and infrastructure partners to develop threat models, interpret findings, and turn promising research into deployed safeguards. - Experience with operating systems, containers or virtualization, distributed infrastructure, or AI agents would also be valuable. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. items.location_text: Chicago, IL; Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY
items.description: Join us in building the future of finance. Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading. About the team + role We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. Robinhood’s People team builds the systems and programs that empower employees to do the best work of their careers, with Total Rewards focused on attracting, retaining, and motivating talent at every stage of their journey. Our Benefits team is small but mighty: we own the health, welfare, retirement, and leave programs employees rely on, and we keep them competitive. We're building something special, and we take that responsibility seriously! We're hiring a Benefits Partner to lead delivery of Robinhood's global health, welfare, retirement, and wellbeing programs. Reporting to the Head of Benefits, you'll shape strategy, drive renewals and vendor performance, lead leave of absence compliance in the US and abroad, and run benefits due diligence on acquisitions. You'll use data, automation, and AI to make sharper cost and plan design decisions and to scale as we enter new markets. This is a high-impact, highly visible role on a team where you'll build as much as you run. This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA, Chicago, IL and New York, NY offices, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. What you’ll do Manage global benefits programs, including US medical, dental, vision, life, disability, spending accounts, COBRA, 401(k), time off, and wellbeing, plus international benefits; setting direction and owning outcomes for cost, competitiveness, and employee experience Lead annual US and international renewals with consultants, brokers, and carrier by negotiating terms, holding vendors to performance guarantees, and driving pricing transparency (including PBM and TPA arrangements) Analyze claims, utilization, cost trend, and vendor performance, building the financial models and benchmarking that support plan changes and budget forecasts Lead US and global leave of absence and benefits compliance, ensuring alignment with federal, state, and international regulations and supporting government filings Support M&A benefits due diligence and integration, assessing target plans and compliance exposure, briefing leadership on risks before close, and helping shape Day 1 versus runway harmonization Benchmark and design competitive benefits as Robinhood enters new markets, partnering with brokers, local advisors, and in-country partners Partner with Internal Comms and PeopleX on benefits education, open enrollment messaging, and employee events, supporting US open enrollment and global renewals end to end Drive process improvements, new plan rollouts, and reporting in Workday, and support employee data auditing for partners in Payroll and Corporate Accounting Apply AI and automation to claims analytics, plan and contract review, benchmarking, and M&A diligence What you bring 7+ years of progressive benefits experience, including management of US health and welfare programs and leave of absence programs 2+ years of hands-on Workday experience Hands-on experience running renewals and managing brokers, carriers, and vendors, including contract negotiation Strong analytical skills and comfort building cost models and translating claims and financial data into clear recommendations International benefits experience across multiple countries Excellent judgment, a sharp eye for detail, and the ability to explain complex topics simply to employees and executives while maintaining confidentiality and professionalism A track record of building with AI, not just using it: you can point to analyses, dashboards, or workflows you've built with AI tools and the impact they had Nice to have: M&A due diligence or integration experience; PBM or TPA transparency work; fintech or high-growth company experience; CEBS or similar certification What we offer Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career. Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching. Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents. Access to the Robinhood Employee Fund that gives eligible US employees the opportunity to invest in a private employee fund that provides exposure to Robinhood Ventures funds. Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not. Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more. Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits. Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more! Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces. If our mission energizes you and you’re ready to build the future of finance, we look forward to seeing your application. AI Usage Disclosure: Robinhood uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our recruiting process. These tools enhance the efficiency and consistency of our hiring process; however, all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams. Robinhood provides equal opportunity for all applicants, offers reasonable accommodations upon request, and complies with applicable equal employment and privacy laws. Inclusion is built into how we hire and work—welcoming different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences so everyone can do their best. Please review the Privacy Policy for your country of application.

items.description: Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” Learn more about working at Coinbase . The Datastores team owns Coinbase's production online databases and caches: Aurora, RDS Postgres, MongoDB Atlas, DynamoDB, ElastiCache (Valkey, Redis), and ClickHouse. We build the paved paths, tooling, and client libraries that let hundreds of engineering teams run reliable, secure, cost-efficient data layers serving millions of requests per second. We are hiring a Staff Software Engineer to help evolve our storage platform: consolidating how databases are provisioned and operated, building zonal resilience and disaster recovery into every production datastore, securing access to data, and giving teams well-paved ways to use it. What you'll do Shape the architecture and multi-year roadmap of Coinbase's storage platform across relational, document, key-value, and caching datastores. Lead platform initiatives from design through production, such as consolidating databases onto shared, proxy-fronted clusters and building client libraries that make applications resilient to failover. Drive resilience and disaster recovery for online datastores: zonal failover, backups and replication, restore tooling, and regular recovery validation. Harden the security and compliance posture of our datastores: encryption and key management, least-privilege access, audit logging, and the controls and evidence that regulators and auditors expect. Deep hands-on experience operating online databases at scale in production (e.g., PostgreSQL/Aurora, MongoDB, DynamoDB, Redis/Valkey, Memcached), including replication, failover, performance tuning, and version upgrades. Solid understanding of distributed database architecture, consistency models, and the trade-offs between datastore technologies. items.title: Applied AI Architect
items.description: About the Team The AI Architect team partners with organizations to turn OpenAI's most capable models into meaningful, real-world impact. We work with customers across industries and digital-native businesses to identify where AI can create value, design secure and scalable solutions, and help those solutions move from early exploration into sustained production adoption. The team brings together technical strategy, customer partnership, and practical deployment expertise, working closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Research, and specialist delivery teams. About the Role As an AI Architect, you will be the senior technical owner for a named portfolio of customers and the primary technical counterpart to their leadership teams. You will act as the “CTO of your book of business”, shaping each customer's AI strategy and guiding their journey from pre-sales discovery and solution evaluation through deployment, adoption, and measurable business impact. You will own the technical account plan across ChatGPT Enterprise, the OpenAI API, Codex, and other agentic AI solutions. In partnership with the Account Director, you will translate business priorities into a focused use-case portfolio, an actionable adoption roadmap, and a clear path to durable customer value and growth. The Account Director owns commercial strategy; you own the technical strategy, customer journey, and path to production value. You will remain accountable for the technical outcome while bringing in the right specialists across deployment, implementation, enablement, security, product, and partners to provide deeper expertise and execute work where needed. This role calls for strong industry fluency, sound architectural judgment, and the ability to move confidently between executive strategy and hands-on technical conversations. items.title: HRIS Analyst
items.description: About Us Fanatics is a leading global sports platform redefining how fans connect with the teams, players and moments they love. Our businesses — Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, Fanatics Betting & Gaming, Fanatics Events, Fanatics Advertising, Fanatics Markets and Fanatics Studios — maximize the presence and reach for hundreds of partners globally and create a one-stop experience that allows fans to buy, bet, collect, and earn, while engaging with sports in deeper, more immersive ways. This includes licensed fan gear and lifestyle products, sportsbook and iGaming, physical and digital trading cards, live events, premium sports entertainment content, credit card offerings and more. Together, they form a powerful, integrated ecosystem — connected by the Fanatics ONE loyalty program and FanCash, the currency of sport — delivering personalized experiences to over 100 million fans worldwide. Fanatics holds partnerships with over 900 sports properties, from professional leagues and players’ associations to teams, colleges and retail partners; over 7,000 athletes and celebrities; and over 2,000 retail locations, including all Lids stores. Backed by a team of more than 22,000 employees, Fanatics is committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience. The Role The HRIS Analyst will transform how HRIS operations are delivered through the practical application of AI, intelligent agents, and automation. This role combines strong knowledge of Oracle HCM, HRIS integrations, data management, and business processes with hands-on AI solution development. The analyst will use AI tools and AI-assisted development to build, enhance, and oversee agents, automated workflows, and solutions that reduce manual intervention and improve efficiency. We already have AI-enabled capabilities in place for integration monitoring and HDL preparation. The analyst will own, expand, and mature these capabilities while providing hands-on operational support and helping establish the processes, documentation, and governance around them. Over time, the goal is to move HRIS operations from a reactive, ticket-driven model to a proactive, scalable, and increasingly automated one, freeing the broader HRIS team to focus on higher-value functional, technical, and strategic work. What You'll Do AI Development & Automation Design, build, and implement AI agents, automated workflows, and scripts that streamline HRIS operations and eliminate repetitive manual work, using AI-assisted development to prototype, test, and refine solutions. Apply an automation-first lens to operational activities, determining where AI, traditional automation, or a combination delivers the best efficiency, accuracy, and reliability. Extend existing AI capabilities across broader HRIS processes, and build reusable solutions, documentation, and knowledge assets that the wider HRIT team can adopt. Coach colleagues on using them. AI-Enabled HRIS Operations Integration Monitoring & Troubleshooting: Mature existing AI-enabled monitoring capabilities into a comprehensive process for detecting failures and anomalies, analyzing logs, managing exceptions, and facilitating issue resolution, including appropriate escalation and approved remediation, in partnership with functional and technical teams. HDL & Data Operations: Expand existing AI-enabled HDL tooling across the end-to-end process, including data intake, transformation, validation, error analysis, load execution, and post-load reconciliation, with defined controls and human approval checkpoints. Testing, Release & Support: Apply AI and automation to testing, regression analysis, release support, reporting, documentation, ticket triage, routine HRIS requests, and knowledge-based support. Operational Support & Continuous Improvement Provide hands-on operational support as business needs require, including ticket resolution, integration troubleshooting, HDL execution, and data corrections, while partnering with HR stakeholders and functional and technical teams. Identify recurring issues and inefficiencies, use AI to investigate root causes, and implement preventative fixes and automation that reduce reactive support. Balance immediate operational demands with ongoing AI development, continuously identifying opportunities to reduce manual activities and progressively transition operations toward more automated, scalable processes. AI Governance, Controls & Oversight Working with IT and Security, establish and maintain governance standards for AI agents, workflows, and automated processes, covering ownership, access, approvals, testing, and monitoring. Ensure solutions include appropriate security, data privacy, auditability, validation, and human oversight. Define levels of autonomy, approval requirements, and escalation paths for AI-driven activities. Maintain documentation, testing evidence, and change controls across each solution's lifecycle, and report the impact of AI and automation through reduced manual effort, improved data quality, faster resolution, and fewer recurring incidents. What We're Looking For Experience supporting Oracle Fusion HCM or a comparable enterprise HRIS platform, with an understanding of HCM business processes, data structures, integrations, and downstream dependencies. Hands-on experience with HRIS integration monitoring, troubleshooting, HDL, data management, and operational support. Demonstrated experience using AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, or Copilot to improve business processes, automate workflows, or solve operational challenges. Demonstrated ability to use AI-assisted development tools and techniques to build practical working solutions, prototype agents and automated workflows, troubleshoot code, and translate business requirements into scalable solutions. Ability to evaluate AI-generated outputs, validate accuracy, identify risks, and apply sound functional and technical judgment. Understanding of data security, access controls, governance, and the importance of human oversight when implementing AI-enabled solutions. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify root causes and turn operational challenges into scalable improvements. Experience with automation and development tools such as SQL, APIs, Power Automate, or comparable low-code solutions. Proactive, innovative mindset and a passion for using AI and automation to improve efficiency, strengthen controls, and change traditional ways of working. You will guide sellers through deal requirements, evaluate non-standard requests, and coordinate the approvals needed to move opportunities through contracting and closure. You will also develop scalable workflows, guidance, and tools that improve deal turnaround times, documentation quality, and consistency across the region. This role partners closely with Sales, Finance, Legal, Pricing, and Revenue Operations, with Product and other teams engaged as needed, to resolve deal issues and support accurate execution from quote through contract and booking. items.title: Software Engineer, Backend - Government Products
items.location_text: Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY
items.description: Join us in building the future of finance. Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading. About the team + role We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. Our engineering group is composed of the Brokerage, Incentives, and Identity teams, which are essential to our core platform and user growth. Together, we build and scale services that support trading, deliver personalized rewards, and protect our customers by preventing fraud. We collaborate with teams across Data Science, Crypto, Security, and Product to build reliable infrastructure! Our culture is high-performing, fast-moving, and ethical in everything we do. As a Software Engineer, Backend - Government Products, you will design, build, and own backend services, infrastructure, and data systems that support Robinhood’s core products. You will solve complex scalability challenges while gaining deep expertise in financial systems and making a direct impact on the products used by millions. In this position, you will build product-facing features and platform enhancements that meet strict correctness standards. You will partner with engineering leads and product managers to deliver impactful technical solutions that expand our services. This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA or New York, NY office(s), with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. What you’ll do Design, build, test, and deploy scalable backend services and systems with a strong emphasis on long-term maintainability. Develop product-facing features and platform enhancements that meet strict correctness and scalability standards. Identify and implement improvements to system performance, engineering productivity, and risk reduction. Collaborate closely with client teams, product partners, and external vendors to deliver impactful technical solutions. What you bring 2+ years of experience in software development. Strong track record of successfully delivering large-scope technical projects in collaborative team environments partnering across engineering, product, and operations. Commitment to high standards in code quality and review processes. Solid understanding of backend development, system design, and the intersection of product and engineering. Proficiency in Go or Python. Hands-on experience with Kafka or similar data streaming technologies. Familiarity with managing and processing large-scale datasets. Bonus points Experience working at a fintech company or financial institution. Familiarity with technologies like Postgres, Kubernetes (K8s), Redis, and AWS (or similar cloud platforms). What we offer Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career. Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching. Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents. Access to the Robinhood Employee Fund that gives eligible US employees the opportunity to invest in a private employee fund that provides exposure to Robinhood Ventures funds. Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not. Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more. Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits. Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more! Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces. Position Restriction: This position is restricted to US citizens or lawful permanent residents In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + equity + benefits. Base pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of job-related factors, which may include education, training, experience, location, business needs, or market demands. The expected base pay range for this role is based on the location where the work will be performed and is aligned to one of 3 compensation zones. For other locations not listed, compensation can be discussed with your recruiter during the interview process. If our mission energizes you and you’re ready to build the future of finance, we look forward to seeing your application. AI Usage Disclosure: Robinhood uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our recruiting process. These tools enhance the efficiency and consistency of our hiring process; however, all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams. Robinhood provides equal opportunity for all applicants, offers reasonable accommodations upon request, and complies with applicable equal employment and privacy laws. Inclusion is built into how we hire and work—welcoming different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences so everyone can do their best. Please review the Privacy Policy for your country of application.

items.title: GTM Strategy & Operations - Strategic Planning
items.location_text: New York City, NY; San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Anthropic's go-to-market organization is growing quickly, and every territory and account assignment has to land correctly for the field to do its best work. The Strategic Planning team sits at the center of that. We work across field Strategy & Operations, Finance, Systems, Data, Incentives and People to help leadership decide where to invest, turn those decisions into a plan, and keep the plan working all year. This role owns the account side of GTM planning, who covers what: territories, the data enrichment and system requirements behind them, rules of engagement (RoEs), and the account moves that follow during the year. You'll join a small, high-leverage team and take end-to-end ownership of that scope. That starts with understanding the plan: how coverage, territories and account data fit together, what assumptions sit underneath them, and what happens downstream when one changes. From there you'll plan your area during the cycle, run it through the year as the business moves, and build the tools that make it easier. When something keeps breaking, we expect you to find out why and fix it at the source. Key responsibilities Build and maintain the territory models and methods behind the plan Partner on segmentation definitions and strategy, and turn them into the account rules and criteria that territories are built on Carry territories from design through validation with the business, QA and go-live Own data enrichment and system requirements for territories and accounts, working with Systems and Data Run account moves and RoEs through the year, and turn one-off requests into a clear process with rules, templates and turnaround times Spot patterns in what breaks after a plan ships and feed them into the next plan's design Build tools and automations with Claude that remove manual work for the Strategy & Operations business partner community You may be a good fit if you Deep alignment to Anthropic’s mission Direct experience with territory design Hands-on experience in sales planning, GTM strategy, revenue operations or a similar analytical role Advanced spreadsheet modeling, including building models that others can follow, audit and reuse Experience working with CRM data such as Salesforce, including accounts, ownership and hierarchies Ability to identify which assumptions matter most in a model and explain the downstream effects of changing them Experience running a process with many stakeholders to a fixed deadline Ability to earn the trust of field leaders and partner teams, and get work done through them without direct authority Track record of moving work forward through teams you don't manage Clear written and verbal communication with both field and leadership audiences Hands-on use of AI tools such as Claude to speed up analysis or remove manual work Strong candidates may also Experience with planning at a company that was scaling its field team quickly Experience enriching CRM data or writing requirements for a systems team Experience with AI/ML companies and consumption business models The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $190,000 — $270,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

items.description: Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” Learn more about working at Coinbase . As a Senior Software Engineer, Core Reliability on the Infra Reliability team within Platform , you'll help Coinbase scale 50x by improving reliability, security, and deployment safety across our production environment. This team owns the systems that secure service configurations and secrets, reduce customer-facing incidents, and strengthen deployment infrastructure supporting thousands of services and hundreds of daily releases. You'll lead high-impact reliability projects that make our entire service environment more resilient and safer for customers. What you'll do: Own the design and delivery of reliability projects and features that improve resiliency across Coinbase's service environment in partnership with other engineering teams. Partner with critical T0/T1 services to understand architecture, improve scalability, and reduce operational toil. Build and enhance systems that securely manage service configurations and secrets at scale. Improve canary-based release systems and expand deployment capabilities to support thousands of services and hundreds of daily deployments with fewer incidents. Drive reliability best practices and strengthen reliability culture across engineering teams at Coinbase. Required Skills and Experience: 5+ years of software engineering experience designing, building, and maintaining production services in service-oriented architectures, including experience with Ruby, Go, Terraform, and cloud platforms (AWS, GCP or Azure). Proven experience with observability and monitoring tools (e.g., Kibana, Datadog) to debug complex production issues, tune system performance, and reduce incident frequency. Experience writing and verbally communicating architecture decisions to cross-functional engineering stakeholders. Ability to participate in on-call rotations and respond to issues outside normal business hours. Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality. items.title: Deployment Strategist Lead - India
items.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. ABOUT THE ROLE As a Deployment Strategist Lead, you'll be fully responsible for opening up a new market for ElevenLabs, and building a team to make it happen. This is a senior position in which you’ll operate as if a co-founder, working alongside an experienced sales leader, of an effective startup moving from 0 -> 1 within our broader org, aiming to deploy our voice AI technology at the most Strategic customers in the market against their most challenging problems. All the while you’ll be able to leverage support from the rest of ElevenLabs to accelerate. You will be responsible for hiring the team you need, winning the first customers in the market and ensuring that our product generates impact for them. No two days are the same, but you should expect to: - Meet with strategic customers to understand their critical audio and voice AI needs and locate their biggest pain points. - Build and lead a team of forward deployed engineers within the region. - Identify relevant use cases through deep engagement with customer problems and workflows, and work with Engineers to implement our voice and audio AI technology into innovative solutions. - Design and architect bespoke integrations for customers, ensuring our technology fits seamlessly into their products and operations. - Guide customers on best practices for implementing our voice and audio AI models to maximize their effectiveness. - Present the results of our work and proposals for future work to audiences ranging from technical teams to C-suite executives. - Collaborate with our Research and Product teams to incorporate field insights into ElevenLabs' software products and AI models. - Build and deliver compelling demos of our voice and audio AI technology to new and existing customers. - Scope out potential applications in new industries and expand our AI solutions across different sectors globally. - Take full ownership of end-to-end execution of major projects for our most strategic partners, working hands-on to deliver high-impact solutions. - Collaborate daily with our customers' engineering and executive teams to ensure optimal implementation of ElevenLabs' technologies. REQUIREMENTS - Executive Stakeholder Engagement: Proven experience engaging and influencing C-suite and VP-level stakeholders, both internally and at customer or partner organizations. - People Leadership: Demonstrated ability to hire, develop, and manage high-performing technical teams while fostering a collaborative and results-driven culture. - Basic proficiency in Python and understanding of API integration to implement scripts and help with prototyping/demo building. - Excellent communication and problem-solving skills, especially in terms of ability to summarize complex technical concepts and using logic in pursuing optimal solutions. - Technical aptitude to quickly understand our voice and audio AI models and their applications. - Strategic and Commercial Awareness: Ability to align technical strategy with business objectives, with an understanding of deal structures, go-to-market motions, and revenue impact. - Nice to have: Partner Ecosystem Development - Experience identifying, building, and nurturing relationships with system integrators, resellers, and technology partners to drive market growth. LOCATION This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in India, with a preference of Bangalore. Expect regular travel for customer onsites. Fluency in English and a deep understanding of the regional and cultural nuances is required. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

You will work across pre- and post-sales, guiding complex enterprise customers from ideation to production while enabling AWS and partners to independently drive deployments. You will combine deep technical expertise, strong judgment, and ecosystem leadership to maximize impact across a portfolio of high-priority opportunities. This preference is that this person is based in our New York, NY office but open to remote (US-East). We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. In this role, you will: STRATEGIC AWS ENGAGEMENT & INFLUENCE - Serve as the senior technical counterpart to AWS field leadership, building trust and credibility across regions and teams. - Influence joint account strategy and technical direction for high-priority opportunities. - Shape how OpenAI engages with AWS by defining engagement models, prioritization frameworks, and best practices. - Proactively identify and drive net-new opportunities and high-impact use cases across the AWS ecosystem. items.title: Senior Client Platform Engineer
items.description: Join us in building the future of finance. Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading. About the team + role We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. Robinhood is looking for a Senior Client Platform Engineer to join our Enterprise Technology organization. The Client Platform Engineering team builds and scales the systems that manage, secure, and support employee devices across Robinhood. We're focused on pushing the boundaries of traditional endpoint management through automation, AI-powered tooling, and modern engineering practices to create a more secure, efficient, and seamless employee experience. In this role, you'll work at the intersection of endpoint engineering, software development, and AI-driven automation. You'll build and maintain the infrastructure, tooling, and automation that power device management across our global workforce, with a strong focus on macOS environments. From developing custom tools and debugging complex systems to leveraging AI to accelerate engineering workflows, you'll have the opportunity to solve challenging technical problems and drive meaningful improvements at scale. You'll join a lean, highly technical team where creativity, resourcefulness, and engineering ownership are essential. You'll partner closely with Security, IT, and Engineering to develop scalable solutions, improve platform reliability, and help shape the future of endpoint management at Robinhood. This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA office, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. What you’ll do Design, build, and scale endpoint management infrastructure supporting macOS, Windows, and mobile devices across Robinhood's global workforce. Develop and maintain custom automation, internal tooling, and configuration management solutions using technologies such as Munki, SaltStack, and MDM platforms. Write, debug, and optimize code to improve device provisioning, configuration management, software deployment, and ongoing endpoint operations. Leverage AI-powered development tools to accelerate automation and engineering workflows, while critically evaluating, troubleshooting, and refining AI-generated code. Build and improve automated testing, deployment pipelines, and workflows to increase the reliability, scalability, and efficiency of endpoint management systems. Monitor device management infrastructure, investigate logs, troubleshoot complex technical issues, and drive root cause analysis and long-term solutions. Identify opportunities to eliminate repetitive manual processes through creative engineering solutions and scalable automation. Partner with Security, IT, and Engineering teams to strengthen endpoint security, improve platform reliability, and support evolving business needs. Provide technical guidance and support to other team members, sharing engineering best practices and helping drive continuous improvement. What you bring 5+ years of relevant experience in Client Platform Engineering, Endpoint Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a similar technical role supporting enterprise device environments. Strong hands-on experience managing enterprise endpoint environments, particularly macOS, using tools such as Munki, SaltStack, and FleetDM solutions. Strong programming and scripting skills, ideally in Python, with demonstrated experience building, maintaining, and debugging custom tools and automation. Proven experience developing automation solutions for device provisioning, configuration management, software deployment, or endpoint lifecycle management. Experience managing and troubleshooting endpoint infrastructure at scale, ideally supporting thousands of devices across multiple operating systems. Ability to understand, troubleshoot, and improve complex codebases, including code generated with AI-powered development tools. Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools and an interest in applying emerging technologies to improve engineering productivity and infrastructure automation. Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with the creativity and resourcefulness to develop practical solutions to complex technical challenges. Experience working across multiple endpoint platforms, with a strong preference for macOS expertise. An engineering-first mindset, strong technical ownership, and a passion for building scalable systems rather than relying on manual processes. What we offer Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career. Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching. items.title: Senior Developer Community Manager
items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. ABOUT THE ROLE We're hiring a Senior Developer Community Manager to help us better engage and connect with the global community of developers and AI practitioners building with Mistral. This is a builder role. Some programs exist in early form; others don't exist yet. You'll design them from scratch, launch them, measure them and scale what works: ambassador and champion programs, creator and influencer partnerships, social-led campaigns, and the day-to-day welcome that turns a first API call into a lasting relationship. You'll be welcoming newcomers, answering questions, and bringing what you hear back to Product, Engineering and Marketing. WHAT YOU'LL DO Build and run community programs end to end - Design, launch and scale an ambassador / champions program: selection criteria, onboarding, enablement, recognition and rewards, governance and offboarding. - Build creator and influencer programs with developer YouTubers, newsletter writers, streamers and technical voices — from identifying and recruiting partners to briefing, early access and measuring impact. - Create social-driven programs and campaigns (challenges, showcases, "built with Mistral" spotlights, launch moments) that get developers creating and sharing. - Support in-person activation where it matters: meetups, hackathons, community-led events and the ambassadors who host them. - Write the playbooks, tooling and processes that let programs run reliably and scale across regions. Engage developers directly - Be a daily, hands-on presence in our community channels: welcome new members, answer questions, unblock developers and route technical issues to the right people. - Proactively reach out to promising builders and projects to invite them into the community and our programs. - Moderate and nurture community spaces so they stay welcoming, safe, inclusive and high-signal. - Represent Mistral at events and in the community, online and occasionally in person. Measure and improve - Set goals and KPIs for each program (e.g. community growth, active members, response time, ambassador output, content reach, sign-ups and API usage attributable to programs). - Build dashboards and report on program health and business impact; iterate based on data. WHO YOU ARE - 6+ years in developer community management, developer relations, developer marketing or a closely related role, ideally at a developer-tools, API, cloud or AI company. - A track record of building community programs from zero to scale — for example an ambassador network, a creator or influencer program, or a contributor program — with measurable business impact. - Equally comfortable setting strategy and doing the work: you write the program plan in the morning and answer questions in Discord in the afternoon. - Technical enough to earn developers' trust: you understand APIs, SDKs and how LLM applications are built, can follow a code sample, and know when to route a question to an engineer. - Genuinely at home in developer spaces online — Discord, GitHub, Reddit, Hugging Face, X, LinkedIn — and you know the culture and etiquette of each. - Excellent written communication in English, with a warm, authentic and concise voice; comfortable representing a brand publicly. - Data-driven: you define KPIs, use analytics and community tooling to assess program health, and tell the story of impact to leadership. - Strong project and stakeholder management across Product, Engineering, Marketing and Partnerships in a fast-moving, sometimes ambiguous environment. - Passion for AI and the open-source ecosystem, with the curiosity to stay current as the field moves. NICE TO HAVE - Fluency in French; other languages are a plus for regional programs. - Hands-on experience building with LLMs (Python or TypeScript), or a public portfolio of projects on GitHub or Hugging Face. - An existing network of developer creators, open-source maintainers or community leaders in the AI space. - Experience with community platforms and tooling such as Discord bots, Discourse, Common Room, Orbit-style analytics or a CRM. - Experience running hackathons, student programs or community-led meetup networks across multiple countries. WHAT WE OFFER We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks. For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link. PRIVACY POLICY Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/applicant-privacy-policy.

items.title: Affiliate Marketing Analyst
items.description: We are looking for an analytical and commercially minded Affiliate Marketing Analyst to support data-driven decision-making within an international iGaming and sports betting business. In this role, you will help maximize the value of affiliate partnerships by connecting player acquisition data with financial performance, identifying growth opportunities, and improving marketing efficiency. Working alongside Affiliate Managers and marketing leadership, you will provide the insights and analytical tools needed to strengthen profitability and support sustainable business growth across regulated markets. Responsibilities: - Assess affiliate performance and acquisition efficiency by analyzing the complete player journey, from impressions and clicks through registrations, first-time and qualified deposits to Gross and Net Gaming Revenue (GGR/NGR) - Evaluate player value and long-term profitability through cohort analysis, retention trends, Lifetime Value (LTV), churn, and payback calculations, identifying the most valuable partners, traffic sources, and customer segments - Support commercial decision-making by building financial models for CPA, tiered Revenue Share, Hybrid, and Flat Fee partnerships, assessing deal profitability, testing different scenarios, and recommending adjustments to commission terms and partner agreements - Develop and maintain analytical reporting solutions, combining SQL-based data extraction and processing with automated dashboards in Power BI, Tableau, or Looker to provide reliable insights for commercial teams and management - Translate performance data into actionable recommendations, delivering weekly and monthly reports on ROAS, deposit activity, acquisition costs, revenue contribution, and margins while highlighting opportunities to improve marketing ROI - Monitor affiliate traffic quality and detect suspicious activity, including bot traffic, click spamming, self-referrals, bonus abuse, multi-accounting, unusual cashouts, and chargebacks - Protect commercial performance and payment accuracy by investigating irregularities, validating affiliate-related data, identifying revenue leakage, and preventing unjustified commission payouts - Collaborate with affiliate and marketing stakeholders to optimize partner relationships, support contract negotiations, and ensure traffic acquisition practices align with applicable regulatory and licensing requirements Requirements: - 2–4+ years of experience in marketing analytics, performance analysis, commercial analytics, or a similar data-focused position, preferably within iGaming, sports betting, FinTech, crypto, or subscription-based digital services - Strong knowledge of affiliate marketing economics and iGaming KPIs, including CPA qualification conditions, GGR, NGR, administrative fee deductions, player LTV, and acquisition profitability - Advanced SQL proficiency, including complex joins, aggregations, CTEs, and window functions, with the ability to work with transactional and event-level data from environments such as Snowflake, BigQuery, or PostgreSQL - Proven experience with BI and reporting tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Looker, combined with advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills for cohort analysis, financial modeling, and scenario planning - Solid understanding of digital attribution and conversion tracking, including UTM tagging, acquisition funnels, and the relationship between marketing activity and player-level financial results - Strong analytical judgment and attention to detail, with the ability to recognize unusual traffic behavior, financial discrepancies, and performance risks and investigate their underlying causes - Ability to communicate complex analytical findings clearly, work effectively with commercial stakeholders, and turn data into practical business recommendations - English at Upper-Intermediate to Advanced (B2–C1) level, suitable for professional communication in an international environment Would be a plus: - Familiarity with Python or R for statistical analysis, predictive modeling, or advanced data processing - Experience using affiliate management platforms, particularly Cellexpert or similar solutions What's in it for you: - Opportunity to work in the dynamic iGaming and sports betting industry - A commercially focused analytical role with direct influence on affiliate profitability and marketing performance - Close collaboration with affiliate management and performance marketing leadership - Exposure to complex acquisition datasets, financial modeling, and advanced business intelligence tools - Opportunities to develop expertise in commercial analytics, marketing attribution, and fraud detection - A professional environment where analytical insights contribute directly to business decisions and operational improvements

items.location_text: United Kingdom, Brazil, United Arab Emirates, Ireland, Peru, Sweden, Colombia, Argentina, Romania, Cyprus, Switzerland, Portugal, Lithuania, South Africa, Czech Republic, Canada, Hungary, Mexico, Chile, Poland, Spain, Bulgaria
items.description: BUILDING THE FUTURE OF OPEN FINANCE Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system. THE TEAM Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients. The opportunity Consumer Growth helps customers get more value from the Kraken app. We improve how people discover relevant features, build confidence using them, and keep coming back. We work closely with Product, Design and Data to understand customer behavior, identify opportunities and test ideas. Our engineers help shape what we build. You’ll bring ideas to the table, challenge assumptions and own your work from the initial hypothesis through launch, measurement and iteration. Ship fast experiments, from a couple of days to a couple of weeks, to improve conversion and retention in the Kraken app. - Find funnel drop-offs and turn them into testable ideas, then build, measure and iterate. - Design, develop and maintain high-quality React Native features for our consumer mobile app. - Help customers discover and adopt relevant features through improvements to customer journeys, incentives and A/B tests. - Use AI to build quickly, then review and ship with a high quality bar. - Deliver polished, user-friendly UI that makes the product feel great to use. - Build for correctness, accessibility, performance and reliability, with testing appropriate to the change. - Work closely with Product, Design, Data and Backend Engineering to define hypotheses and measure results. - Instrument your work so the team can evaluate customer behavior and experiment results, and use what you learn to improve, expand or stop an experiment. - Turn successful experiments into reliable, maintainable product experiences. - Proactively spot gaps and opportunities, and take ownership of the outcome. WHAT YOU BRING - Strong experience building production mobile apps with React Native and TypeScript. - A product and growth mindset, focused on moving metrics rather than just shipping code. - Evidence of product impact: you can explain what you built, why you built it and what you learned after launch. - Curiosity about data, and comfort using analytics tools such as Mixpanel and Segment. - Experience working in a scale-up or other high-growth, fast-moving environment. - Fluency in using AI tools to build, review and ship code, while retaining ownership of engineering decisions and the quality of the result. - A strong eye for UI quality and polish. - A self-directed approach, with the confidence to find problems and fix them without being asked. - Comfort working from an ambiguous customer problem, proposing ideas and finding a small, useful change to test. - Collaborative working style across Product, Design and Engineering. - Strong written and verbal communication skills in English. NICE TO HAVES - Hands-on experience running A/B tests and experiments, ideally with Statsig or a similar tool. - Experience with large-scale consumer products used by millions of people. - Agency or consulting background shipping across multiple products. - Experience in consumer fintech, payments or crypto apps. Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution. We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance. OUR COMMITMENT Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto. We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision. As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.
