items.title: Safer Gambling Analyst
items.description: ABOUT THE ROLE Our mission is to create the safest and greatest online gaming experience and our dedicated team of executives are at the forefront of identifying and interacting with our customers to educate and inform on how to remain safe whilst enjoying our sites. We want to be there for our customers, so this role covers 6am till 2am, 365 days a year with varying shift patterns covering day and night shifts. Details to be discussed during the interview. YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR: - Interpreting and analysing data sets from customer accounts, following key patterns and trends that may indicate problem gambling. - Monitoring player behaviour and making risk based, self driven decisions - Promote the importance of sustainability across external and internal stakeholders. - Building relationships with our customers via email, chat, and phone across all of our managed brands - Coach our frontline teams to make informed decisions to safeguard our players and protect our brand reputation. - A keen eye for detail and the ability to think on your feet. - Educating and providing information to all staff regarding Safer Gambling strategies and procedures. - Keep up to speed with regulatory requirements and process changes, which will affect our customers to ensure good decision making OUR SUCCESSFUL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE THE FOLLOWING: - Experience of working within a multi-channel customer service environment - Enthusiastic; self-motivated team worker - Confident handling data and making analytical decisions - An Investigative mindset and critical thinker - A decision maker with the ability to handle objections or concerns with first-time resolution - Ability to understand and interpret information from a range of data sources to make well judged evidence based decisions - Excellent oral and written communication - Previous experience in the gambling industry is desirable WHO WE ARE At the core of LeoVegas Group is Team Leo. Our culture is our foundation and is what enables us to innovate, build, and lead as we trailblaze our way through the igaming industry. We’re a team of over 2000 innovators, initiators, and groundbreakers working in a fast-paced and agile environment across 19 offices worldwide. BENEFITS - Hybrid working - 3 days per week at the office, with flexibility for 2 days at home - Workation – Take your job on an adventure with our Workation benefit for up to 4 weeks per year (T&Cs apply). - Plenty of time to recharge – 28 days of paid leave, plus all public and bank holidays in England. - Invest in your future – We match pension contributions up to 6%. - Comprehensive healthcare – BUPA coverage, including pre-existing conditions, plus a cashback plan for dental, optical, and other treatments. - Wellbeing allowance – £250 annual allowance for you to invest in your health and wellbeing (T&Cs apply). - A great workplace experience – Talented colleagues, complimentary snacks and drinks, as well as breakfasts and lunches on a weekly basis - A social culture you’ll love – Regular opportunities to attend sporting events throughout the year, plus a quarterly team budget for even more fun. - Support for growing families – Up to 6 months of full pay for maternity leave. - Stay active & save money – Cycle-to-work scheme and gym discounts to keep you moving. - Work in style – at our newly renovated offices at Tailors Corner are just a 2-minute walk from Leeds Train Station. - And there’s more… We’ll share even more perks related to your role when you chat with our Talent Acquisition team! JOIN US! In our pride, we empower our teammates to find their roar and run with their wildest ideas. We don’t wait for things to happen; we pounce and make it happen! Would you be a good fit for the Leo Pride - give us a roar! As our company working language is English, we’d like to see your CV in English, please

items.title: B2B Marketing - India
items.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. ABOUT THE ROLE We're looking for a senior B2B Growth Marketer to build and scale demand generation for ElevenLabs in India. This is a hands-on, in-country role focused on generating enterprise pipeline, growing our brand with technical buyers, and creating programs that become benchmarks for B2B marketing in AI. Your work will shape how Indian businesses discover, evaluate, and adopt ElevenLabs. The goal is to build repeatable marketing engines that make ElevenLabs the top choice for every enterprise. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Build integrated B2B marketing campaigns end to end across India's priority industries from strategy and messaging through execution and measurement. - Localize and execute programs across ABM, content, events, webinars, partner/customer marketing, executive branding, product launches, and outbound - choosing the right channel for the problem rather than owning a single function. - Adapt global campaigns and messaging for the Indian market, and feed local insights (buyer behavior, competitive dynamics, regulatory context) back to the global team. - Partner closely with local sales and the global product marketing, growth, and design teams to keep messaging consistent and execute high-impact campaigns. - Own pipeline generation and campaign performance for the market, using data to measure results, run experiments, and continuously improve what works. REQUIREMENTS - 5 to 7 years of experience at a high-growth technology company - you've built and scaled B2B demand generation programs that created measurable enterprise pipeline, and you know what moved the needle. - Ownership Pedigree: You have implemented growth and marketing projects from start to finish and held yourself accountable for the ROI. - Deep knowledge of the Indian market: its enterprise buyers, media landscape, and business culture, ideally with an existing network. - Work well without much process. This role spans multiple marketing functions and needs someone who sets priorities, spots opportunities, and moves quickly as our first marketer in the market. - Relentless commitment to excellence — a high bar for quality, clarity, and impact. - Curious about AI, follows the technology ecosystem closely, and has exceptional judgment on what makes marketing stand out. #LI-Remote We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

items.description: ABOUT THE ROLE Perplexity is growing fast, and every new employee, laptop, SaaS app and integration expands what we have to protect. We want enterprise security that's strong by default, mostly automated, and invisible to people doing their jobs. We're looking for an Enterprise Security Engineer to own the security of how Perplexity works internally: our identities, devices, SaaS applications and corporate access. You'll sit on the Security Engineering team and work closely with IT, building controls and automation together so the secure path is also the easy one. RESPONSIBILITIES - Own identity security: SSO and MFA policy, conditional access and device trust, privileged and admin access, service accounts, and break-glass procedures. - Harden our SaaS stack. Manage OAuth app and integration risk, admin roles, sharing and retention settings, and audit logging across our core collaboration and productivity tools. - Define and enforce endpoint security baselines with IT, across EDR, device management, disk encryption, OS and browser policy, and software allowlisting. - Build access governance that scales: just-in-time and request-based access, regular access reviews, and joiner/mover/leaver automation that removes access promptly and reliably. - Write detections for corporate threats such as account takeover, OAuth abuse, data exfiltration, insider risk and malicious extensions, and respond when they fire. - Automate everything you can. Write code and infrastructure-as-code to configure systems, remediate drift, and replace manual tickets with self-service workflows. - Secure corporate network access and email, including zero-trust remote access, phishing protection and domain security. - Partner with IT, People, Legal and GRC on new tools and vendors, security reviews, and evidence for compliance programs. QUALIFICATIONS - 4+ years in security engineering, with significant time on corporate or enterprise security, identity, or endpoint security. - Hands-on depth with at least one major identity provider (such as Okta or Entra ID), including SSO, SCIM, MFA and conditional access policy. - Experience securing SaaS environments such as Google Workspace or Microsoft 365, Slack, and developer tools, including OAuth and third-party app risk. - Experience with endpoint security and device management across macOS (and ideally Windows and Linux), including EDR, MDM and configuration baselines. - Proficiency in at least one programming language (such as Python or Go) and comfort building automation against vendor APIs. Experience with infrastructure-as-code is a plus. - Experience writing detections and investigating incidents with a SIEM or log platform. - Good judgment about trade-offs between security and productivity, and the ability to roll out controls without slowing the company down. - Bonus: experience at a fast-growing company where you built enterprise security from an early stage. - Bonus: experience securing AI tools and agents in the workplace, such as agent access to SaaS data, browser agents, and AI app governance.

items.title: Founding Technical SDR
items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. ABOUT THE ROLE This is an opportunity to help build Mistral's inbound business development motion in the US. Our sales team focuses primarily on enterprise opportunities, meaning there's a growing opportunity to engage the developers, startups and mid-market companies discovering and experimenting with Mistral through our self-serve platform. You'll be the first point of contact for many of these prospective customers, owning inbound engagement from initial signup and enquiry through to qualification and handover to the relevant sales team. You'll engage with developers and technical decision-makers, understand what they're building, help them navigate our platform and identify opportunities to grow their usage into larger commercial relationships. This isn't a traditional high-volume BDR/SDR role. You'll combine technical curiosity, commercial instinct and a proactive approach to relationship building. You'll also help establish the processes, engagement strategies and qualification criteria that will shape how we develop this function as Mistral scales. Working closely with Demand Generation and our digital-native sales team, you'll have the opportunity to build something from the ground up, with meaningful ownership from day one. Please note that this role starts as a six-month contractor position, with the potential to transition into a permanent position as the function develops. WHAT YOU'LL DO Own inbound engagement and qualification - Manage and respond to inbound interest from developers, startups and digital-native businesses discovering Mistral through Studio, our Inference API, website and other channels. - Engage prospective customers quickly, understand their technical requirements, use cases and business objectives, and determine how Mistral can support them. - Help developers navigate the early stages of adoption, including account setup, API access and initial integration questions. - Qualify opportunities based on technical fit, potential usage, business needs and commercial readiness. - Identify promising accounts and coordinate effective handovers to our digital-native sales team. Drive developer adoption and engagement - Proactively follow up with developers and teams who have signed up but haven't yet activated or progressed their usage. - Build relationships with early-stage startups, AI-first companies and technical teams, helping them understand the capabilities and potential applications of Mistral's models. - Identify opportunities to re-engage stalled accounts and move developers from experimentation towards production. - Represent Mistral at relevant conferences, hackathons and developer community events, following up on interest and generating new opportunities. Help build our inbound growth engine - Develop repeatable outreach, qualification and follow-up processes to improve inbound conversion and customer engagement. - Use CRM data and product usage signals to prioritise accounts, identify buying intent and understand what drives conversion. - Experiment with AI tools, agents and automation to improve prospect research, account monitoring and engagement workflows. - Share customer feedback, emerging use cases and market insights with Product, Marketing, DevRel and Sales. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - Experience in an inbound BDR, SDR, business development or commercial role, ideally within a technology, SaaS, developer-platform or AI business. - Confidence engaging with technical audiences, including developers, engineers, founders and technical decision-makers. - A working understanding of APIs, developer tools and modern AI platforms. You don't need to be an engineer, but you should be comfortable navigating technical documentation and understanding how customers build with our products. - Strong discovery and qualification skills, with the ability to understand customer needs, identify commercial potential and progress opportunities effectively. - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to adapt your approach to different technical and business audiences. - A proactive, organised approach to managing inbound leads, prioritising follow-ups and maintaining momentum across multiple opportunities. - Commercial curiosity and an analytical mindset, using data and customer signals to identify where to focus your efforts. - An interest in AI and the developer ecosystem, with a willingness to get hands-on with Mistral's products and understand our competitive positioning. - Comfort working in a fast-moving, evolving environment where you'll help establish processes rather than simply follow an existing playbook. Nice to have - Experience working with LLM platforms, open-weight models or inference APIs. - Familiarity with developer-focused SaaS or product-led growth environments. - Experience using CRM platforms, sales engagement tools and AI-powered automation. - Exposure to developer communities, hackathons or technical events. WHY JOIN US? - Build a new function: Be the first person dedicated to developing our US inbound BDR motion. - Work at the forefront of AI: Engage directly with developers and companies building with frontier AI technology. - Own meaningful opportunities: Work closely with our digital-native sales team and help turn early product interest into commercial relationships. WHAT WE OFFER We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks. For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link. PRIVACY POLICY Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/applicant-privacy-policy.

items.title: Staff Software Engineer, Data Infrastructure
items.description: WHO ARE WE? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems. We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! WHY THIS ROLE? The Data Infrastructure team at Cohere is responsible for the storage and data movement layer underlying every model training run. We're building the unified storage layer that feeds our training workloads at petabyte scale. In this role, you would have the opportunity to architect and lead the design of this system from the ground up, serving petabytes of training data and model checkpoints fast enough to keep thousands of GPUs busy across several training clusters. You'd be a key contributor, leading the effort to solve a problem few teams have tackled at this scale. IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL: - Design, architect, and operate the distributed storage system that feeds model training and evaluation, driving the technical vision from concept through production. - Lead and own the deployment of this system across multiple Kubernetes clusters at petabyte scale, setting standards and best practices for the organization. - Collaborate with researchers and training-infra teams to define how jobs read and write data, translating those patterns into throughput, latency, and durability requirements that shape the platform's roadmap. - Navigate the networking, I/O, and consistency challenges of moving large datasets and checkpoints across regions and backends, with GPU idle time and time-to-insight as the key metrics of success — and drive the solutions that improve them. YOU MAY BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU HAVE: - Strong storage fundamentals, including replication, consistency, caching, and data lifecycle management, with demonstrated architecture and design experience. - Strong coding ability in Python and Go, with the ability to lead implementations and mentor others in either language, and the willingness to contribute to the other. - Proven experience running stateful systems on Kubernetes, including Persistent Volumes, CSI drivers, and StatefulSets, with the capacity to design and execute operational strategies. - Hands-on experience with cloud object storage such as S3 as well as POSIX-style filesystems. IT’S A BONUS IF YOU HAVE: - Experience with parallel or HPC filesystems such as Weka, VAST, or Lustre, and a track record of applying them at scale. - Familiarity with the data-loading and checkpointing patterns used in large-scale model training, with the ability to innovate on them. - An interest in how large models are trained and evaluated, including the trajectory and eval data those runs generate, and a desire to understand the workloads the platform is serving — with the capacity to guide others in that understanding. FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS: - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch. - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health. - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme. - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent. - Annual enrichment benefits: Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit. Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching. - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!) - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite. HOW AND WHERE WE WORK: - Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon. - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events. - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city. - Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly. If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12a6IrLdF3kI2nonKSr4tiFuz18rLQbaeYV-JM9L4o9Q/edit, and we will work together to meet your needs. We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider. Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers https://cohere.com/careers page.

items.description: Enterprises are rolling Perplexity out to thousands of employees and connecting it to their most sensitive internal data. Their security teams want to know how to do that safely, and they want to hear it from someone who has done real security work. ABOUT THE ROLE We're looking for a Cybersecurity Solutions Architect to be that person. You'll be the security expert our enterprise customers work with as they deploy Perplexity: running architecture and hardening sessions with their security leads, reviewing how they're configuring identity, data access, and admin controls, and helping them get to a setup they're confident in. You'll sit on the Security team and work closely with our enterprise sales, customer success, and product teams, and you'll bring what you learn from customers back into how we build and secure the product. RESPONSIBILITIES - Lead security architecture workshops and hardening reviews with enterprise customers' security and IT teams as they deploy Perplexity. This covers identity and SSO/SCIM, connectors to internal data, access controls, data retention, admin and audit settings, and managed browser and endpoint policy. - Act as the technical security voice in strategic enterprise deals. Answer deep security reviews and questionnaires, and represent our security posture to CISOs and security architects. - Build and maintain the materials customers rely on: hardening guides, reference architectures, configuration baselines, and security FAQs. - Help customers configure enterprise controls in their own environments, such as identity providers, MDM and device management tools like Microsoft Intune, and data source permissions. Troubleshoot when something doesn't apply as expected. - Turn recurring customer security requests into product feedback. Work with product and engineering to prioritize the controls enterprises need. - Partner with account executives and customer success on customer-specific security asks, and know when to bring in Security Engineering or Legal. - Track common customer concerns and gaps, and help shape how we communicate security and trust externally. QUALIFICATIONS - 5+ years in security engineering, security architecture, or a customer-facing security role such as solutions architect, sales engineer, or security consultant. - Hands-on depth in enterprise identity and access (SSO, SAML/OIDC, SCIM, conditional access) and in SaaS security configuration. - Working knowledge of the Microsoft ecosystem (Entra ID, Intune, M365, Purview) and at least one other major enterprise stack, such as Google Workspace or Okta. - Comfortable leading technical conversations with CISOs and security architects. Able to say no, explain trade-offs plainly, and earn trust in the room. - Familiarity with compliance frameworks enterprise customers ask about, such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, and FedRAMP, and with how they map to product controls. - Clear written communication. You can turn a messy customer environment into a crisp set of recommendations. - Bonus: experience securing AI or LLM products, agent integrations, or data connectors in enterprise environments. - Bonus: background in browser security, endpoint management, or data loss prevention.

items.title: Head of India Policy, Global Affairs
items.description: About the Team: OpenAI’s mission is to ensure that artificial general intelligence (AGI) benefits all of humanity. Achieving this goal requires more than cutting-edge research—it demands deep, ongoing engagement with the policymakers, communities, and institutions shaping the future of AI. The Global Affairs team leads this engagement. We cultivate authentic, collaborative relationships with public officials, regulators, multilateral bodies, civil society leaders, and the broader AI policymaking community to ensure that diverse perspectives inform our work. By bringing external insights into OpenAI and sharing our own learnings transparently, we help advance thoughtful regulation, responsible industry standards, and governance frameworks that promote the safe and beneficial development of AI technologies. In close partnership with our research, product, and policy colleagues, we work across regions to anticipate emerging issues, craft forward-looking strategies, and champion policies that align technological progress with human values. Our mission is to help shape the global conversation on AI and ensure that the benefits of this transformative technology reach people everywhere. About the Role As Head of India Policy, Global Affairs you will lead OpenAI’s public policy strategy, government engagement, and policy partnerships in India. You will help shape an environment that supports safe AI development and deployment, expands access to its benefits, and advances India’s ambitions for innovation and economic opportunity. You will serve as a senior policy representative to Indian institutions and build partnerships that turn shared priorities into practical results. Working with Global Affairs leaders worldwide and colleagues in India, you will connect national and state priorities with OpenAI’s work on responsible adoption, public services, AI skills, and research. This role is based in New Delhi, India, and requires travel within India and internationally. In this role, you will - Set and execute OpenAI’s India policy strategy, translating global priorities into focused national campaigns with clear goals, milestones, and measures of policy progress and public benefit. - Build durable relationships with central and state governments, Parliament, regulators, industry, and civil society. Engage constructively across political perspectives and bring local insights into OpenAI’s decisions. - Develop policy positions, consultation responses, and advocacy on AI governance, safety, privacy, copyright, and liability, working closely with Legal and specialist policy teams. - Anticipate political and regulatory developments and give leadership clear, actionable advice on risks, opportunities, and tradeoffs affecting OpenAI and the people who use our products. - Design and deliver partnerships with government, universities, nonprofits, and industry that strengthen AI fluency, support research, and improve public services. Advance local-language access and measure sustained use and outcomes for underserved communities. - Work with commercial, technical, and infrastructure colleagues to address policy and procurement barriers to responsible adoption and support AI infrastructure opportunities aligned with India’s needs. - Coordinate policy engagement around product launches and sensitive issues, including youth safety, election integrity, and cybersecurity. Partner with central response teams to ensure timely, accurate engagement with public institutions. - Represent OpenAI in policy forums and support senior executive engagements. Lead cross-functional projects and external advisers with disciplined prioritization, resource management, and follow-through. You’ll thrive in this role if you: - 10 or more years of relevant experience in public policy, government, technology, or international affairs, including responsibility for senior stakeholder engagement in India. - Understand India’s political institutions, central and state policymaking, and digital economy, and have a record of building trust with senior public officials and diverse communities. - Have delivered meaningful policy outcomes and complex partnerships, with evidence of your ability to set strategy, build coalitions, and carry work through implementation. - Understand AI policy and can quickly develop fluency in technical issues, explain them clearly, and exercise sound judgment about innovation, safety, and public trust. - Lead through influence across legal, research, product, communications, and commercial teams, and turn competing priorities into clear decisions and coordinated action. - Communicate and write exceptionally well in English for policy, technical, and public audiences. Professional proficiency in Hindi or another Indian language is an advantage. - Demonstrate integrity, intellectual curiosity, and a collaborative approach. You are comfortable with ambiguity, open to challenge, and motivated by OpenAI’s mission. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. items.title: Member of Technical Staff (Perplexity Frontier Research)
items.location_text: New York City, Palo Alto, London, San Francisco
items.description: Welcome to the application portal for Perplexity Frontier Research. This initiative develops fundamentally new algorithms, models, and evaluations. We are building an automated scientist that can conduct deep research, and provide the best quality service at the lowest cost. We are hiring research scientists for permanent, full-time positions at the initiative. One application covers all focus areas. - Please refer to the Perplexity Frontier Research https://research.perplexity.ai homepage for full details on the initiative and application. - When you're ready to apply, please complete and submit the application form. Please carefully follow all instructions. - Our focus areas include orchestration, pre-training, continual learning, reinforcement learning, systems, and evaluations. - We will be releasing our work as papers, blog posts, and code. - The anticipated annual base salary range for U.S.-based positions is $250,000–$550,000, plus equity. This range is a guideline; we offer competitive salary and equity based on experience, expertise, and the scope of the role. - We'll evaluate applications on a rolling basis, with priority consideration for submissions received by December 5, 2026. - You should write your application without assistance from other humans or AI models. Submitting writing from other humans or AI models as your own will result in permanent disqualification from employment at Perplexity. Qualifications: 1. Strong foundations and engineering fluency: probability, optimization, linear algebra and algorithms, plus Python and a deep learning framework, with code that scales. 2. Range: researchers who are proficient engineers, and engineers who are also researchers. Everyone here builds. 3. Evidence of excellence: a result, a system, a proof, or a model that other people use or build on. 4. A preference for understanding, and clear, simple communication: controls, ablations, honest baselines, and simple explanations. 5. Agency, creativity, low ego: fix what's broken without being asked, ask questions that are not yet fashionable, and let ideas win on evidence. 6. Helpful, not required: a PhD in a technical discipline, machine learning papers of outstanding quality, prior work in one of our focus areas, or large-scale empirical work with large models.

We are driven by technology and innovation, continuously evolving our proprietary platform to deliver seamless and engaging online entertainment experiences to our growing customer base. Certified as a Great Place to Work® several years in a row, in Greece, Malta and Brazil, we are a global team, united by a culture of trust, inclusion and shared learning. Join us and become part of a global team where collaboration, innovation and continuous growth drive everything we do. What we are looking for As a Payments Category Manager , you will be part of the Procurement Department and you will be responsible for managing procurement activities related to payment solutions and services, developing supplier relationships and ensuring cost efficiency and operational excellence. What you will work on Manage relationships with existing and prospective payment providers, monitor performance and lead commercial reviews and negotiations Negotiate processing fees, reserves, related commercial role Proven experience in the online gaming / iGaming industry Demonstrated success negotiating commercial agreements with PSPs and acquiring banks Strong understanding of payment processing, card acquiring, alternative payment methods, settlement cycles, chargebacks, and payment fee structures Proven track record of reducing payment costs and improving commercial terms Strong analytical skills and experience with financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, and KPI monitoring Experience with contract management, vendor evaluation, and commercial benchmarking Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills; experience with BI tools is an advantage Excellent negotiation, communication, and stakeholder management skills Fluency in English, written and spoken Experience with items.title: Technical Support Specialist (Technical Support Team)
items.description: Semrush is a brand visibility platform, empowering marketers to command their online presence and create measurable impact. We unify SEO authority and AI visibility, so brands are found, cited, and chosen everywhere search happens. That’s how Semrush gained the trust of over 28 million users—from scaling startups to Fortune 500 companies. Here, you own the way you work, but we move as one unbeatable team. We don’t just lead the market, we’re busy creating the world where Semrush is an unfair advantage for every marketer. We move fast in ways to help you grow. Here, you have room to experiment, keep what works, and learn quickly from what doesn’t. Ready to share our ambition and make an impact? Then, this role may be for you. About the role 1. Technical Support & Troubleshooting Investigate and resolve complex technical, product-related, billing, and account issues escalated by CS, CSM, and Sales teams. Troubleshoot issues related to SEO, website functionality, and Semrush products. Handle advanced billing, subscription, and account operations using authorized internal tools. Identify recurring issues, investigate root causes, and recommend solutions. 2. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Communication Work closely with Product and Development teams to investigate technical issues, communicate findings, and support resolution. Manage technical escalations and ensure clear communication between teams. Collaborate with internal stakeholders to address operational challenges, share insights, and support process improvements. Participate in side projects and cross-functional initiatives aimed at improving products, internal tools, and support workflows. 3. Knowledge Sharing & Team Enablement Provide training and technical guidance to CS specialists across different locations. Identify knowledge gaps and help colleagues strengthen their technical and product expertise. Create, maintain, and improve internal documentation, troubleshooting guides, and knowledge base materials. Share best practices and solutions to recurring or particularly challenging cases. 4. Continuous Improvement Identify recurring technical issues and provide actionable feedback to Product and Development teams. Contribute to optimizing support processes, escalation workflows, and case handling quality. Proactively suggest improvements that enhance team efficiency and customer experience. About you Move together. Raise the bar. Learn fast—grow faster. That’s the default. And here’s what else is needed to succeed in this role: Must Have Previous experience in technical or customer support within a SaaS environment . Hands-on experience with SEO and a solid understanding of SEO principles and tools. Good understanding of web technologies, including HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. Ability to investigate complex issues and communicate technical solutions clearly. Strong attention to detail, ownership, and cross-functional collaboration skills. Nice to Have Experience with Semrush or similar SEO and digital marketing platforms. Experience handling billing, subscription, and account-related requests. Experience creating internal documentation or training support teams. About the perks Unlimited PTO Hobby & team building budget allowance Employee Support Program Loss of family member financial aid Employee Resource Groups A little more about us Semrush is the leading brand visibility platform, empowering marketers to command their online presence and create measurable impact. Built on the industry’s most expansive proprietary dataset, Semrush delivers AI-driven insights across GEO, SEO, Agentic Search Optimization, content marketing, paid media, and social strategy. The company was founded in 2008 and is headquartered in Boston, MA with a global presence across North America, Europe and Asia. We’ve built something people are proud to be part of. And the awards agree: Great Place to Work, DEI Workplace, Diversity Champion Award, International Inclusion Award, Most Women Friendly Employers, Best Place for Working Parents. All thanks to 1700+ employees who build the company every day. About our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion commitments Semrush is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to ensure that everyone feels a sense of belonging in the workplace. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, creed, color, national origin, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, ancestry, physical or mental disability, or medical condition including medical characteristics, genetic identity, marital status, military service, or any other classification protected by applicable local, state or federal laws. Ready to be a part of this mission? Join us!

items.title: Full Stack Software Engineer, Travel
items.description: ABOUT THE TEAM OpenAI’s Consumer Verticals team builds experiences that make ChatGPT more useful in the areas that matter to people every day. Within Travel, we’re exploring how AI can help people discover destinations, compare options, and plan trips around their preferences and needs. Travel planning brings together inspiration, personal preferences, and practical constraints—from budgets and schedules to changing prices and availability. We aim to make that complexity easier to navigate, combining advanced AI capabilities, relevant travel information, and thoughtful product design to help people move from an idea to a trip with greater confidence. We work closely with product, design, research, safety, privacy, and other ChatGPT teams to turn emerging AI capabilities into useful consumer experiences, with a high bar for quality, reliability, and user trust. ABOUT THE ROLE We’re looking for a product-minded full stack software engineer to help shape the next generation of travel experiences in ChatGPT. You will own features end-to-end, from early exploration and prototypes through launch and iteration. Your work will span intuitive interfaces, backend services, and integrations that connect conversational experiences with travel information and services. This role is ideal for engineers who enjoy shaping new product areas, making complex information intuitive, and moving quickly from idea to production. Prior experience in AI or travel is not required. IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL - Build consumer travel experiences across ChatGPT’s web and mobile surfaces, with ownership spanning frontend interfaces, backend services, and external integrations. - Translate travelers’ preferences and constraints into useful experiences for discovering destinations, comparing stays and transportation, and planning itineraries. - Build integrations with travel data and services - Partner with product, design, and research to turn AI capabilities into intuitive, personalized products and shape what to build next. - Design reliable experiences that handle incomplete information, and service failures while giving users clear choices and control. - Improve quality, performance, and usability through experimentation and user feedback, with privacy, safety, and user trust built into the product. YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU - Have 10+ years of software engineering experience, with depth in full-stack development. - Have shipped consumer products at scale and can own features across interfaces, APIs, services, and data flows. - Bring strong product judgment and a high bar for craft, especially when making complex choices easy to understand. - Enjoy shaping product direction and owning ambiguous problems from idea to production. - Move quickly while making thoughtful tradeoffs around quality, reliability, and user trust. - Are excited to apply AI to travel and help people turn their preferences and plans into useful next steps. BONUS IF YOU HAVE - Experience with AI-powered applications, conversational interfaces, or multimodal products. - Experience building travel, marketplace, commerce including integrations with external providers. - Experience with personalization, search and discovery, or systems that depend on frequently changing data. - Experience with privacy-sensitive products, secure data flows, permissions, or user consent. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. items.title: Engineering Manager, Billing Platform
items.location_text: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY | Seattle, WA
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Anthropic exists to ensure the world safely navigates the transition through transformative AI. That work is funded by commercial revenue — and every dollar of it runs through Billing Platform. We build and operate the infrastructure that turns product usage into revenue across everything Anthropic ships: Claude.ai, the Developer Platform, Claude Code, and all that comes next. The faster we can price it, charge for it, and account for it correctly, the faster Anthropic can fund the mission. Pricing Foundations is the team within Billing that turns a signed enterprise agreement into something every system can act on. We own the model and the systems of record for what a customer bought: their commitments, their pricing terms, how many organizations roll up to one agreement, and the automation that provisions a signed deal across Anthropic's products and the cloud platforms where Claude is sold. When a deal closes, our systems decide what the customer is entitled to, what they pay, and what Finance reports. We're looking for an engineering manager to lead this team. You'll hire and grow the team, set its technical direction, and own how it delivers. Success looks like new deal structures shipping as configuration rather than one-off engineering, and signed deals provisioning automatically, with the rare exception routed to someone who can fix it. Key responsibilities Lead and grow the team. Hire, coach, and develop engineers, give clear and honest feedback, and build a team that owns its domain end to end. Own the commercial data model. Set the direction for how commitments, pricing terms, account hierarchies, and entitlements are modeled, so a new deal structure extends the model instead of working around it. Own the pricing primitives: the catalog of products and rates, and the constructs that let contracted pricing follow a customer across products and new model launches. Make the contract the source of truth. Build systems of record that Finance can close the books on and trace back to the signed contract, with reconciliation against the CRM and every downstream billing system designed in from the start. Automate the path from signature to a live customer. Lead the durable workflows that provision a signed deal across Anthropic's products and the cloud platforms where Claude is sold, recover from partial failure, and route exceptions to the right person with the context to resolve them. Build for people and agents. Own the interfaces for agreements, entitlements, and pricing terms that seller tools and Claude-powered agents read and write, so both get the same safe, auditable capabilities. Own planning and delivery. Turn competing asks from Sales, Deal Desk, Finance, Legal, and product teams into a clear roadmap, make the trade-offs explicit, and hold the team to its milestones. Operate what you ship. Set SLOs on the flows your team runs, instrument them so discrepancies surface before month-end close, and keep on-call sustainable as volume grows. Minimum qualifications 8+ years of industry experience, including 3+ years leading software engineering teams including hiring, coaching and performance management. A strong background building production backend systems, with enough depth in a language such as Go, Python, or Java to review designs and code. Experience leading teams that built billing, payments, pricing, contract management, or other financial systems of record in production. Experience modeling transactional or financial data, including relational databases and SQL. Experience leading teams that built and operated asynchronous, long-running workflows, such as on a durable workflow engine like Temporal or on queues and state machines. Preferred qualifications Experience building CPQ, contract management, or quote-to-cash platforms, and firsthand knowledge of how one change to pricing terms ripples through quoting, provisioning, invoicing, and revenue reporting. Experience with enterprise commercial structures such as multi-year or ramped commitments, drawdowns, amendments and renewals, or one agreement shared across many accounts. Experience integrating or extending third-party billing, payment, or CRM platforms, and opinions on where they fall short. Experience building revenue reconciliation or financial reporting pipelines, or systems that had to pass a financial audit. Experience automating a high-touch operational process and measuring the manual work it removed. Experience building LLM-powered tools or agents, or systems designed for agents to call safely. Experience growing a team through a period of rapid company growth. The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $405,000 — $485,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.
